title.zh: 卷16 本紀十六 仁宗本紀
title.raw: 卷16 本紀十六 仁宗本紀

sentences.zh: 仁宗受天興運敷化綏猷崇文經武孝恭勤儉端敏英哲睿皇帝，諱顒琰，高宗第十五子也。

translations.literal: The Emperor Renzong, who received Heaven's mandate, raised the realm, spread transformation, secured the plan, honored culture, regulated arms, was filial, respectful, diligent, frugal, upright, keen, wise, and perspicacious—taboo name Yongyan—was the fifteenth son of the Gaozong Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong, taboo Yongyan, was Hongli's fifteenth son; his posthumous titles praise Heaven's mandate, civil and military order, and frugal sagacity.

sentences.zh: 母魏佳氏，追尊孝儀皇后。

translations.literal: His mother was of the Wei clan; she was posthumously honored as Empress Xiaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: His mother, the Wei clan, became Empress Xiaoyi posthumously.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十五年十月初六日生。

translations.literal: He was born on the sixth day of the tenth month, Qianlong 25.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in Qianlong 25, tenth month, day 6.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，封嘉親王。

translations.literal: In year 54 he was enfeoffed as Prince Jia.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 54 he became Prince Jia.

sentences.zh: 六十年九月，策立為皇太子，高宗將傳位焉，以明年為嘉慶元年。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of year 60 he was installed as heir apparent; the Gaozong Emperor would transmit the throne, with the following year as Jiaqing 1.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 60, month 9, Yongyan became heir apparent; Hongli would abdicate and the next year would be Jiaqing 1.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年丙辰春正月戊辰朔，舉行內禪，上侍高宗遍禮於堂子、奉先殿、壽皇殿。

translations.literal: Jiaqing 1, bingchen year, spring, first month, new moon on day wuchen: the internal abdication was performed; the Emperor attended the Retired Emperor in performing rites throughout at the Hall of the Ancestors, the Hall of Imperial Forebears, and the Hall of Imperial Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiaqing 1 New Year, wuchen, the abdication rites were held; Yongyan accompanied the Retired Emperor at the ancestral halls.

sentences.zh: 高宗御太和殿，授璽。

translations.literal: The Retired Emperor presided at the Hall of Supreme Harmony and transmitted the seals.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli took the Hall of Supreme Harmony and handed over the seals.

sentences.zh: 上即位，尊高宗為太上皇帝，訓政。

translations.literal: The Emperor took the throne, honored the Retired Emperor, who continued to instruct in government.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyan ascended; Hongli became Retired Emperor and still guided policy.

sentences.zh: 頒詔天下，賜宴宗藩。

translations.literal: An edict was promulgated empire-wide and a feast given to the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaqing issued an empire-wide edict and feasted the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，立皇后喜塔拉氏。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Empress Xitala was installed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Empress Xitala was enthroned.

sentences.zh: 寧壽宮舉行千叟宴，太上皇帝蒞焉。

translations.literal: At the Palace of Tranquil Longevity a Feast of a Thousand Elders was held; the Retired Emperor attended.
translations.idiomatic: The Thousand Elders Banquet at Ningshou Palace included the Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 九十以上者，召至御座，賜卮酒如故事。

translations.literal: Those aged ninety and above were summoned to the imperial seat and granted a cup of wine, as in precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Men of ninety and more came to the throne for the cup-of-wine rite, as of old.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祈穀於上帝。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, prayer for grain was offered to the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Emperor prayed for grain to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上奉太上皇帝賜廷臣宴於正大光明殿。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor, attending the Retired Emperor, granted the court ministers a feast at the Hall of Great Brightness.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Yongyan with the Retired Emperor feasted ministers at the Hall of Great Brightness.

sentences.zh: 凡賜宴皆如之。

translations.literal: All such feasts followed this practice.
translations.idiomatic: Every such feast followed the same form.

sentences.zh: 辦理苗疆大學士福康安等奏攻克朗坡，進攻平隴。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Fukang'an and others, managing the Miao frontier, memorialized capture of Langpo and advance against Pinglong.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an reported Langpo taken and an advance on Pinglong.

sentences.zh: 湖北枝江、宜都教匪起。

translations.literal: Teaching-bandit rebels rose in Zhijiang and Yidu, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: White Lotus rebels rose in Zhijiang and Yidu, Hubei.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑朔，釋奠先師孔子。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day dingchou: the sacrifice to Confucius was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dingchou new moon, the Emperor sacrificed to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Emperor sacrificed to soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，初舉經筵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Classics Lecture was inaugurated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Classics Lecture began.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敕甘肅貴德廳建文廟。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, an edict ordered a Confucian temple built at Guide subprefecture, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Guide, Gansu, was ordered to build a Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 戊子，春分，朝日於東郊。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, at the spring equinox the sun was worshipped at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the spring equinox, the Emperor worshipped the sun in the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上御乾清門聽政，園居則御勤政殿，以為常。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor held court at the Gate of Heavenly Purity to hear government; when at the garden residence he held court at the Hall of Diligence in Government, as the regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Yongyan heard government at Qianqing Gate, or at the Diligence Hall when at the garden.

sentences.zh: 己亥，湖北當陽教匪起，戕官。

translations.literal: On day jihai, teaching-bandit rebels rose in Dangyang, Hubei, and killed officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, rebels in Dangyang, Hubei, killed officials.

sentences.zh: 西安將軍恆瑞率兵二千剿之。

translations.literal: Xi'an General Heng Rui led two thousand troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Heng Rui marched two thousand men from Xi'an to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祭歷代帝王廟。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the temple of successive emperors was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Emperor sacrificed at the temple of past emperors.

sentences.zh: 丙午，湖北巡撫惠齡奏獲教匪聶傑人。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Hubei Governor Hui Ling memorialized capture of the teaching-bandit Nie Jieren.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Hui Ling reported capturing rebel leader Nie Jieren.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，停四川續徵軍需銀兩。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu: continued collection of military-supply silver in Sichuan was halted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, gengxu, Sichuan's continued military-supply levy was stopped.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上耕耤田，四推。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor plowed the sacred field, four furrows.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Emperor plowed the sacred field with four passes.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上奉太上皇帝謁陵。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor, attending the Retired Emperor, went to worship at the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Yongyan accompanied the Retired Emperor to the tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，車駕還京。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the court returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇后祀先蠶。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Empress sacrificed to the Silkworm Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Empress performed the silkworm rite.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，恆瑞奏收復湖北竹山。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Heng Rui memorialized recovery of Zhushan, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Heng Rui reported recovering Zhushan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，留保住免。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Liu Baozhu was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Liu Baozhu was removed.

sentences.zh: 以烏爾圖納遜為理藩院尚書，富銳為綏遠城將軍，永慶為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Wuer'tunaxun was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; Fu Rui was made Suiyuan garrison general; Yongqing was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wuer'tunaxun took the Colonial Affairs ministry; Fu Rui, Suiyuan; Yongqing, the Mongol command.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔，時享太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day bingzi: seasonal sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, bingzi new moon, the Emperor sacrificed at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 命宜綿、永保、恆瑞、孫士毅等分剿湖北教匪。

translations.literal: Yi Mian, Yongbao, Heng Rui, Sun Shiyi, and others were ordered to suppress the Hubei teaching bandits in separate columns.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian, Yongbao, Heng Rui, and Sun Shiyi were ordered to crush Hubei rebels in separate forces.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，常雩，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, at the summer solstice Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the summer solstice, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 以剿來鳳功，晉四川總督孫士毅三等男。

translations.literal: For merit in suppressing rebels at Laifeng, Sichuan Governor Sun Shiyi was promoted to third-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi became a third-rank baron for crushing Laifeng rebels.

sentences.zh: 敕伊犁貢馬由草地行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered tribute horses from Ili sent by the overland route.
translations.idiomatic: Ili tribute horses were ordered overland.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上侍太上皇帝祈雨黑龍潭。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor, attending the Retired Emperor, prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Yongyan with the Retired Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 是日，雨。

translations.literal: That day, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賜趙文楷等一百一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zhao Wenkai and one hundred one others received jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhao Wenkai and 101 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，詔額魯特來京有出痘者，嗣後由草地赴熱河覲見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen: an edict said that hereafter Oirat visitors to the capital who had had smallpox should come by the overland route to Rehe for audience.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, wushen, Oirat visitors with smallpox history were ordered to audience at Rehe by the overland route.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祭地於方澤。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Emperor sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上奉太上皇帝避暑木蘭。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor, attending the Retired Emperor, went to escape summer heat at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yongyan accompanied the Retired Emperor to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以富綱為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Fu Gang was made grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Fu Gang took the grain-transport command.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大學士、貝子福康安卒於軍。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Grand Secretary and Imperial Prince Fukang'an died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Fukang'an died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day yihai: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the sixth-month new moon, yihai, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以魁倫為閩浙總督，朱珪為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Kui Lun was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Zhu Gui was made Liang-Guang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Kui Lun took Fujian-Zhejiang; Zhu Gui, Liang-Guang.

sentences.zh: 以紀昀為兵部尚書，金士松為禮部尚書，沈初為左都御史。

translations.literal: Ji Yun was made Minister of War; Jin Shisong Minister of Rites; Shen Chu Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Yun took war; Jin Shisong, rites; Shen Chu, the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 丙子，調福昌為福州將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Fu Chang'an was transferred to be Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Fu Chang'an became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 以明亮署廣州將軍。

translations.literal: Mingliang was ordered to act as Guangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang acted as Guangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，除山西代州三州縣水沖田賦。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, water-scoured field taxes were remitted for three subprefectures and counties of Daizhou, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, three Daizhou districts lost water-scoured field taxes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，和琳奏獲苗匪石三保，解京誅之。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, He Lin memorialized capture of the Miao bandit Shi Sanbao, who was sent to the capital and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, He Lin sent captured Miao leader Shi Sanbao to the capital for execution.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，江南豐汛河決。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Fengxun River breached its banks in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the Fengxun River broke through in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，明亮奏剿平孝感縣教匪。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinhai: Mingliang memorialized that teaching bandits in Xiaogan county had been suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, xinhai, Mingliang reported Xiaogan rebels suppressed.

sentences.zh: 大學士、四川總督、三等男孫士毅卒於軍。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary, Sichuan Governor, and third-rank Baron Sun Shiyi died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi, grand secretary and Sichuan governor, died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，以雨停秋獮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: because of rain the autumn hunt was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, bingzi, rain canceled the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，和琳卒於軍，命明亮、鄂輝接統軍務。

translations.literal: On day renyin, He Lin died in camp; Mingliang and E'hui were ordered to take over military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, He Lin died in camp; Mingliang and E'hui took command.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，車駕還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yisi: the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, yisi, the court returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，上萬壽節，詣太上皇帝行禮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuyin: on the Emperor's birthday he went to perform rites before the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuyin, Yongyan's birthday rites began with homage to the Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 禮成，受廷臣賀。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, he received congratulations from the court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: After the rites he received court congratulations.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以董誥為大學士。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Dong Gao was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Dong Gao joined the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 王傑以足疾疏辭軍機處、南書房、禮部事，允之。

translations.literal: Wang Jie, citing foot ailment, memorialized to resign from the Grand Council, Southern Studio, and Ministry of Rites affairs; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jie resigned from the Grand Council, Southern Studio, and Rites over foot ailment.

sentences.zh: 命沈初為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Shen Chu was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Chu joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，贈征苗陣亡提督花連布太子少保，予世職。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Brigadier Hua Lianbu, who died fighting the Miao campaign, was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the fallen Miao-campaign general Hua Lianbu received posthumous honors and a hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，調沈初為兵部尚書，以紀昀為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Shen Chu was transferred to be Minister of War and Ji Yun was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Shen Chu took war and Ji Yun the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，豐汛河工合龍復決。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: the Fengxun river works, though closed, breached again.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, gengxu, the Fengxun dike closed and broke again.

sentences.zh: 予湖北死事巡檢王翼孫、訓導甘杜、典史浦寶光世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary offices were granted to Hubei officials who died in service—Patrol Inspector Wang Yisun, Instructor Gan Du, and Registry Clerk Pu Baoguang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yisun, Gan Du, and Pu Baoguang of Hubei received hereditary posts for dying in service.

sentences.zh: 甲子，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, at the winter solstice Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the winter solstice, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，江西巡撫陳淮有罪，逮問遣戍。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Jiangxi Governor Chen Huai was guilty of crimes, arrested and questioned, and sent into exile.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Chen Huai of Jiangxi was arrested, tried, and exiled.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以湖北教匪偷渡滾河入秦，褫永保職逮問，以惠齡統其軍。

translations.literal: On day jisi, because Hubei teaching bandits had slipped across the Gun River into Shaanxi, Yongbao was stripped of office and arrested for trial; Hui Ling was put in overall command of his army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yongbao was arrested after rebels crossed into Shaanxi; Hui Ling took his army.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，湖南苗匪平，封明亮伯爵，額勒登保侯爵，及德楞泰等世職有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi: Hunan Miao bandits were pacified; Mingliang was enfeoffed as earl, E'le Dengbao as marquis, and Delengtai and others received differentiated hereditary offices.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, wuzi, Hunan Miao rebels were pacified; Mingliang became earl and E'le Dengbao marquis.

sentences.zh: 庚子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the joint winter sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Emperor performed the winter ancestral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上奉太上皇帝御太和殿，賜宴朝正外藩。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor, attending the Retired Emperor, presided at the Hall of Supreme Harmony and granted the New Year feast to foreign tributaries at court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Yongyan with the Retired Emperor feasted foreign tributaries at New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免順天、江蘇、山西、湖南、福建等省三十九廳州縣災賦逋各賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster tax arrears were remitted by varying amounts for thirty-nine subprefectures, prefectures, and counties in Zhili, Jiangsu, Shanxi, Hunan, Fujian, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, thirty-nine disaster districts in several provinces lost tax arrears by degree.

sentences.zh: 會計天下民數二萬七千五百六十六萬二千四十四名口，穀數三千七百二十萬六千五百三十九石一升二合七勺。

translations.literal: The empire's population was reckoned at 275,662,044 persons; grain at 37,206,539 piculs, 1 sheng, 2 ge, and 7 shao.
translations.idiomatic: The empire counted 275,662,044 people and 37,206,539 piculs of grain.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute that year.

sentences.zh: 二年丁巳春正月丁卯，貴州南籠仲苗夷婦王囊仙作亂，命總督勒保剿之。

translations.literal: Second year, dingsi year, spring, first month, day dingmao: the Zhong Miao woman Wang Nangxian of Nanlong, Guizhou, rebelled; Governor Lebao was ordered to suppress her.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2, dingmao, Wang Nangxian of Nanlong, Guizhou, rebelled and Lebao was sent to suppress her.

sentences.zh: 庚午，觀成奏四川教匪徐添德侵擾達州、東鄉，命總兵朱射斗等剿之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Guan Cheng memorialized that the Sichuan teaching-bandit Xu Tiande had raided Dazhou and Dongxiang; Brigade General Zhu Shedou and others were ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Guan Cheng reported Xu Tiande raiding Dazhou and Zhu Shedou was sent against him.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiyou: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, guiyou, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 江南豐汛復報合龍。

translations.literal: Jiangnan again reported the Fengxun breach closed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan again reported the Fengxun dike closed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇后崩，奉太上皇帝誥，素服七日，不摘纓。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Empress died; following the Retired Emperor's instruction, plain dress was worn for seven days without removing the queue tassel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Empress died; by the Retired Emperor's order the court mourned seven days in plain dress without removing queue tassels.

sentences.zh: 廷臣如之，近臣常服不掛珠。

translations.literal: Court ministers did likewise; close attendants wore ordinary dress without court beads.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers followed suit; close attendants wore plain dress without beads.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敘景安剿擒教匪功，晉三等伯。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, for merit in suppressing and capturing teaching bandits, Jing An was promoted to third-rank earl.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Jing An became a third-rank earl for capturing rebels.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，冊諡大行皇后曰孝淑皇后。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the late Empress was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaoshu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the late Empress was titled Xiaoshu.

sentences.zh: 惠齡奏獲匪首劉起等，解京誅之。

translations.literal: Hui Ling memorialized capture of the bandit chiefs Liu Qi and others, who were sent to the capital and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Hui Ling sent captured chiefs Liu Qi and others to the capital for execution.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day wushen: the Emperor went to worship at the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, wushen, the Emperor went to the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，還京。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以劉墉為大學士，調沈初為吏部尚書，朱珪為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Liu Yong was made Grand Secretary; Shen Chu was transferred to be Minister of Personnel; Zhu Gui was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Liu Yong joined the Grand Secretariat; Shen Chu took personnel; Zhu Gui, war.

sentences.zh: 以福長安、慶桂為滿洲都統，德楞泰為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Fu Chang'an and Qing Gui were made Manchu commanders-in-chief; Delengtai was made Chinese Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Chang'an and Qing Gui took the Manchu command; Delengtai, the Chinese Banner command.

sentences.zh: 巴克坦布、慶成奏，由應山追賊入豫，查明賊首李全、王廷詔、姚之富均在其內。

translations.literal: Baketanbu and Qing Cheng memorialized that in pursuit from Yingshan into Henan it was verified that the bandit chiefs Li Quan, Wang Tingzhao, and Yao Zhifu were all among them.
translations.idiomatic: Baketanbu and Qing Cheng reported Li Quan, Wang Tingzhao, and Yao Zhifu among rebels pursued from Yingshan into Henan.

sentences.zh: 諭令擒捕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered their capture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered them seized.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，設湖南鎮筸鎮總兵官，改保靖土縣為流官。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renshen: a Zhenbi garrison commander was established in Hunan and Baojing native county was changed to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, renshen, Hunan gained a Zhenbi garrison commander and Baojing became a regular county.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，追贈侍郎奉寬太師、禮部尚書，上受書師也。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Vice Minister Feng Kuan was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor and Minister of Rites—he had been the Emperor's teacher in receiving the Classics.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Feng Kuan, the Emperor's Classics teacher, was posthumously made grand preceptor and minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，上奉太上皇帝避暑木蘭。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: the Emperor, attending the Retired Emperor, went to escape summer heat at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, wuchen, Yongyan accompanied the Retired Emperor to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，惠齡奏教匪姚之富等由白馬石搶渡漢江入川。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Hui Ling memorialized that the teaching bandit Yao Zhifu and others had crossed the Han River at Baimashi into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Hui Ling reported Yao Zhifu and others crossing the Han into Sichuan at Baimashi.

sentences.zh: 詔罷總統慶成、恆瑞等，各降官，以宜綿為總統，明亮、德楞泰為幫辦。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed the overall commanders Qing Cheng, Heng Rui, and others, each demoted in rank; Yi Mian was made overall commander, with Mingliang and Delengtai as assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Cheng and Heng Rui were demoted; Yi Mian took overall command with Mingliang and Delengtai as assistants.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，勒保奏，剿辦南籠仲苗，迭克水煙坪、卡子河等處。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: Lebao memorialized that in suppressing the Nanlong Zhong Miao he had taken in succession Shuoyanping, Kazi River, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, guiyou, Lebao reported successive captures at Shuoyanping, Kazi River, and elsewhere against Nanlong Miao rebels.

sentences.zh: 得旨：亟將苗首仙姑等擒獲。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript stated: capture the Miao chiefs including Xianggu at once.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Xianggu and other Miao leaders seized immediately.

sentences.zh: 閏六月庚子，吉慶奏克西隆州亞稿苗寨。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day gengzi: Ji Qing memorialized the capture of the Yagao Miao stockade in Xilong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary month 6, gengzi, Ji Qing took the Yagao Miao stockade at Xilong.

sentences.zh: 丙午，勒保奏進克普坪，搶斃匪首，解南籠圍。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Le Bao memorialized the advance capture of Puping, the killing of rebel chiefs in the assault, and the relief of the Nanlong siege.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Le Bao took Puping, killed rebel chiefs, and lifted the Nanlong siege.

sentences.zh: 詔獎紳民堅守危城，深明大義，改南籠府為興義府。

translations.literal: An edict praised the gentry and people for holding the endangered city and understanding righteousness, and changed Nanlong prefecture to Xingyi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised Nanlong's defenders and renamed the prefecture Xingyi.

sentences.zh: 勒保續報解黃草壩圍，滇、黔路通。

translations.literal: Le Bao further reported the relief of the Huangcaoba siege and the opening of the Yunnan-Guizhou routes.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao also reported Huangcaoba relieved and Yunnan-Guizhou routes open.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，軍機章京吳熊光、戴衢亨均加三品卿銜，與侍郎傅森一體在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Grand Council clerks Wu Xiongguang and Dai Quheng were both given third-rank noble titles and, like Vice Minister Fu Sen, were ordered to study and serve under the Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wu Xiongguang and Dai Quheng gained third-rank titles and joined Fu Sen studying under the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，永定河決。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jisi: the Yongding River breached.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, jisi, the Yongding River broke its banks.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾二回城儲糧備荒。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Kashgar and Yengisar were ordered to store grain against famine.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Kashgar and Yengisar were told to stock grain for famine.

sentences.zh: 癸未，都統巴克坦布卒於軍。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Commander Baketanbu died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Commander Baketanbu died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，免四川運送軍糈奉節六州縣明年額賦。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, next year's quota taxes were remitted for six Sichuan prefectures and counties including Fengjie that transported army grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, six Sichuan grain-transport counties including Fengjie were forgiven next year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，永定河合龍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiachen: the Yongding River was closed again.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jiachen, the Yongding breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，范宜恆卒，調沈初為戶部尚書，紀昀為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Fan Yiheng died; Shen Chu was made Minister of Revenue and Ji Yun Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Fan Yiheng died; Shen Chu took revenue and Ji Yun took rites.

sentences.zh: 己未，大學士誠謀勇公阿桂卒。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Grand Secretary Duke of Chengmou Yong Agui died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Grand Secretary Agui died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上奉太上皇帝還京。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor escorted the Retired Emperor back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Emperor brought the Retired Emperor back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，勒保奏攻克仲苗賊巢，獲賊首王囊仙等，解京誅之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuchen: Le Bao memorialized the capture of the Zhong Miao rebel lair and the seizure of rebel chiefs including Wang Nangxian, who were sent to the capital for execution.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, wuchen, Le Bao took the Zhong Miao lair and sent Wang Nangxian and other chiefs to the capital for execution.

sentences.zh: 封勒保三等侯。

translations.literal: Le Bao was enfeoffed as third-rank marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao was made a third-rank marquis.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上臨奠故大學士阿桂。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor attended mourning for the late Grand Secretary Agui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Emperor mourned the late Grand Secretary Agui.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以蘇凌阿為大學士，李奉翰為兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Su Linga was made Grand Secretary and Li Fenghan Jiangnan-Jiangxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Su Linga joined the Grand Secretariat and Li Fenghan took the two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔宜綿、勒保、奉承恩、景安等分募鄉勇入伍剿賊。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, an edict ordered Yimian, Le Bao, Feng Shen'en, Jing An, and others to recruit braves separately for enlistment against the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Yimian, Le Bao, Feng Shen'en, and Jing An were told to recruit braves against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔曰：「聞賊每逼平民入夥，迎拒官軍。

translations.literal: On day guisi, an edict stated: "We hear that rebels constantly force common people to join bands and face the imperial army."
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, an edict said rebels forced civilians into bands to fight the army.

sentences.zh: 官軍報捷，所稱殺賊，多系平民，非真賊也。

translations.literal: "When the army reports victory, those called killed rebels are mostly civilians, not real rebels."
translations.idiomatic: Victory reports mostly counted civilians as rebels, not real bandits.

sentences.zh: 故日久無功。

translations.literal: "Hence for long there has been no real success."
translations.idiomatic: So the campaign had long made little real progress.

sentences.zh: 領兵大員尚其設法解散，勿令玉石俱焚。

translations.literal: "Commanders in the field should devise means to disperse them and not burn jade with common stone."
translations.idiomatic: Field commanders were told to disperse bands and avoid killing innocents with rebels.

sentences.zh: 」甲午，以湖北恩施、利川，四川奉節士民奮勇殺賊，再免一年錢糧。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, because the gentry and people of Enshi and Lichuan in Hubei and Fengjie in Sichuan fought rebels bravely, one more year of taxes was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Enshi, Lichuan, and Fengjie were forgiven another year of taxes for killing rebels.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，明亮、德楞泰請廣修民堡，以削賊勢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu: Mingliang and Delengtai requested widespread repair of civilian forts to weaken the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuxu, Mingliang and Delengtai asked to build more civilian forts against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 詔斥其迂緩。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked them as dilatory.
translations.idiomatic: The court rebuked the plan as too slow.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，乾清宮交泰殿災。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Jiaotai Hall in the Palace of Heavenly Purity burned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Jiaotai Hall in the Palace of Heavenly Purity burned.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命勒保總統四川軍務。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Le Bao was ordered to take overall command of Sichuan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Le Bao was made overall commander in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅朔，予陣亡散秩大臣佛住、護軍統領阿爾薩朗世職。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day bingyin: hereditary offices were granted to the fallen scattered-rank minister Fozhu and guard commander A'ersalang.
translations.idiomatic: At the eleventh-month new moon, Fozhu and A'ersalang received hereditary offices.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，以康基田為江南河道總督，司馬騊為東河河道總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: Kang Jitian was made Jiangnan Canal governor-general and Sima Tao eastern-route canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, wushen, Kang Jitian took the Jiangnan canals and Sima Tao the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 予陣亡總兵明安圖，副將曾攀桂、伊薩納等世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary offices were granted to the fallen commander-in-chief Ming'antu and vice commanders Zeng Pangui and Yisana.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'antu, Zeng Pangui, and Yisana received hereditary offices for dying in battle.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the combined autumnal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the autumnal temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免順天、湖廣、陝西、雲南、甘肅等省五十七州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for fifty-seven prefectures and counties in Zhili, Huguang, Shaanxi, Yunnan, Gansu, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year fifty-seven disaster districts in several provinces received partial tax relief.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年戊午春正月庚午，以梁肯堂為兵部尚書，胡季堂為直隸總督。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day gengwu: Liang Kentang was made Minister of War and Hu Jitang Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, month 1, gengwu, Liang Kentang took war and Hu Jitang took Zhili.

sentences.zh: 甲申，調勒保為四川總督。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Le Bao was transferred to be Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Le Bao became Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，額勒登保奏獲賊首覃加耀。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Eledengbao memorialized the capture of rebel chief Tan Jiayao.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Eledengbao reported capturing rebel chief Tan Jiayao.

sentences.zh: 上責其遲延，奪額勒登保爵職。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked his delay and stripped Eledengbao of rank and office.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor blamed the delay and stripped Eledengbao of rank and office.

sentences.zh: 並以疏防奪明亮、德楞泰爵職，奪舒亮、穆克登阿職，籍其家，均隨軍自效。

translations.literal: For lax defense Mingliang and Delengtai were also stripped of rank and office; Shuliang, Mukedeng'a, and others were dismissed and their property confiscated, all to redeem themselves on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang and Delengtai lost rank for lax defense; Shuliang and Mukedeng'a were dismissed, their property seized, and all sent to redeem themselves in the field.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，上釋奠文廟，臨雍講學。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei: the Emperor performed the Confucian sacrifice and lectured at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dingwei, the Emperor sacrificed at the Confucian temple and lectured at the Academy.

sentences.zh: 以鄂奇泰為黑龍江將軍，慶霖為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: E Qitai was made Heilongjiang general and Qinglin Jiangning general.
translations.idiomatic: E Qitai took Heilongjiang and Qinglin took Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，柯藩、烏爾圖納遜坐縱陝賊漢入楚，褫職。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Ke Fan and W'ertunaxun were stripped of office for letting Shaanxi Han rebels enter Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Ke Fan and W'ertunaxun lost office for letting Shaanxi rebels into Hubei.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以吳省欽為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Wu Shengqin was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wu Shengqin became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命內閣學士那彥成在軍機處學習行走。

translations.literal: On day maomao, Grand Secretariat academician Nayancheng was ordered to study and serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On maomao, Nayancheng was told to study at the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，德楞泰奏，追剿賊首齊王氏、姚之富，投崖死。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: Delengtai memorialized that in pursuit he drove rebel chiefs Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu over a cliff to their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, dingchou, Delengtai reported Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu driven off a cliff to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 予明亮副都統銜。

translations.literal: Mingliang was given the vice censor-in-chief title.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang received the vice censor-in-chief title.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以剿賊遲延，褫觀成、劉君輔職。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Guan Cheng and Liu Junfu were stripped of office for delay in suppressing rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Guan Cheng and Liu Junfu lost office for slow suppression.

sentences.zh: 以富成為成都將軍。

translations.literal: Fucheng was made Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: Fucheng became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙寅，免福建全省遠年逋賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day bingyin: long-overdue taxes were remitted for all Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingyin, Fujian's long-overdue taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己巳，截留江西漕糧，接賑山東曹縣等十三州縣被水災民。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Jiangxi tribute grain was held back to relieve flood victims in thirteen Shandong prefectures and counties including Caoxian.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Jiangxi tribute grain was diverted to thirteen flooded Shandong districts including Caoxian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上奉太上皇帝避暑木蘭。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor escorted the Retired Emperor to summer at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Emperor took the Retired Emperor to summer at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，以剿賊遲延，盡奪德楞泰爵職，予副都統銜自效。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: for delay in suppressing rebels Delengtai was wholly stripped of rank and office and given the vice censor-in-chief title to redeem himself on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jiyou, Delengtai lost all rank for delay but kept a vice censor title to fight on.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，雲貴總督、三等男鄂輝卒。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general third-rank baron E Hui died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general E Hui died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，富楞泰卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengwu: Fulengtai died.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, gengwu, Fulengtai died.

sentences.zh: 以德勒格楞貴為寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: Dele'gelenggui was made Ningxia general.
translations.idiomatic: Dele'gelenggui became Ningxia general.

sentences.zh: 以雨停秋獮。

translations.literal: Because of rain the autumn enclosure hunt was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Rain canceled the autumn enclosure hunt.

sentences.zh: 八月，以獲教匪王三槐功，晉勒保及和珅公爵，福長安侯爵。

translations.literal: Eighth month: for capturing the sect rebel Wang Sanhuai, Le Bao and Heshen were advanced to duke and Fu Chang'an to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, capturing Wang Sanhuai raised Le Bao and Heshen to duke and Fu Chang'an to marquis.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張誠基奏江西西寧州教匪作亂，剿平之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Zhang Chengji memorialized that sect rebels rose at Xining prefecture in Jiangxi and were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhang Chengji reported and suppressed sect rebels at Jiangxi Xining.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，上奉太上皇帝還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: the Emperor escorted the Retired Emperor back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, guihai, the Emperor brought the Retired Emperor back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祀明總制袁崇煥於賢良祠。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Ming general Yuan Chonghuan was enshrined at the Shrine of Eminent Statesmen.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Yuan Chonghuan was enshrined at the Shrine of Eminent Statesmen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，新建乾清宮交泰殿成。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: the rebuilt Jiaotai Hall in the Palace of Heavenly Purity was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, gengzi, the rebuilt Jiaotai Hall was finished.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，左都御史舒常卒。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dinghai: Left Censor-in-Chief Shu Chang died.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, dinghai, Left Censor-in-Chief Shu Chang died.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，惠齡奏獲賊首羅其清、羅其書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yimao: Huiling memorialized the capture of rebel chiefs Luo Qiqing and Luo Qishu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, yimao, Huiling captured rebel chiefs Luo Qiqing and Luo Qishu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the combined autumnal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the autumnal temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免陝西、貴州等省四十八廳州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for forty-eight departments and counties in Shaanxi, Guizhou, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year forty-eight disaster districts in Shaanxi, Guizhou, and elsewhere received partial tax relief.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年己未春正月壬戌，太上皇帝崩，上始親政。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day renxu: the Retired Emperor died and the Emperor began to rule in person.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, month 1, renxu, the Retired Emperor died and the Emperor took personal rule.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大學士和珅有罪，及尚書福長安俱下獄鞫訊。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Grand Secretary Heshen was found guilty and, with Minister Fu Chang'an, was imprisoned for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Heshen was convicted and imprisoned with Fu Chang'an for trial.

sentences.zh: 晉儀郡王永璇親王，貝勒永璘為慶郡王，綿億封履郡王，奕綸、奕紳在上書房讀書，綿志等各封賞有差。

translations.literal: Prince of Yi Yongxuan was advanced to prince of the first rank, Prince Qing Yonglin to Prince Qing of the second rank, Mianyi to Prince of Lu, Yilun and Yishen to study in the Upper Study, and Mianzhi and others were enfeoffed with varying rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxuan, Yonglin, Mianyi, Yilun, Yishen, and Mianzhi received promotions and enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 詔：「中外陳奏直達朕前，不許副封關會軍機處。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Memorials from within and without shall reach Us directly; sealed copies may not be routed through the Grand Council."
translations.idiomatic: An edict required memorials to reach the throne directly, not through the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 」命成親王永瑆、大學士董誥、尚書慶桂在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Prince Cheng Yongxing, Grand Secretary Dong Gao, and Minister Qinggui were ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxing, Dong Gao, and Qinggui joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 沈初免直。

translations.literal: Shen Chu was removed from regular attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Chu left regular Grand Council attendance.

sentences.zh: 成親王永瑆管戶部。

translations.literal: Prince Cheng Yongxing was put in charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Cheng Yongxing took charge of revenue.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，和珅賜死於獄，福長安論斬。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Heshen was ordered to die in prison and Fu Chang'an was sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Heshen was ordered to die in prison and Fu Chang'an sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 己卯，特詔申明軍紀。

translations.literal: On day jimao, a special edict reaffirmed military discipline.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, a special edict reaffirmed military discipline.

sentences.zh: 命勒保為經略，明亮、額勒登保為參贊，並查詢劉清居官，具實保奏。

translations.literal: Le Bao was made supreme commander, Mingliang and Eledengbao made deputies, and Liu Qing's official conduct was to be investigated and truthfully recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao became supreme commander with Mingliang and Eledengbao as deputies; Liu Qing was to be investigated and recommended.

sentences.zh: 吳省欽免，以劉權之為左都御史。

translations.literal: Wu Shengqin was dismissed and Liu Quanzhi made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shengqin left office and Liu Quanzhi became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 以保寧為大學士，仍管伊犁將軍，慶桂協辦大學士，書麟為吏部尚書，松筠為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Baoning was made Grand Secretary while still managing the Ili generalship; Qinggui was made assisting Grand Secretary; Shulin Minister of Personnel; Songyun Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Baoning joined the Grand Secretariat while keeping Ili; Qinggui assisted; Shulin took personnel and Songyun revenue.

sentences.zh: 敘斬賊首冉文儔功，獎敘惠齡、德楞泰。

translations.literal: Merit was recorded for the slaying of rebel chief Ran Wen'ou and rewards were granted to Huiling and Delengtai.
translations.idiomatic: Slaying Ran Wen'ou brought merit registers and rewards for Huiling and Delengtai.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，宜綿解任，以恆瑞為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Yimian was relieved and Hengrui made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yimian left office and Hengrui took Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，贈原任御史曹錫寶副都御史，蔭一子。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the former censor Cao Xibao was posthumously given the vice censor-in-chief title and one son was granted office by inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the late censor Cao Xibao was posthumously honored and one son ennobled.

sentences.zh: 召前內閣學士尹壯圖來京。

translations.literal: The former Grand Secretariat academician Yin Zhuangtu was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Former academician Yin Zhuangtu was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，以松筠為陝甘總督，布彥達賚為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day jichou: Songyun was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general and Buyandabai Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jichou, Songyun took Shaanxi-Gansu and Buyandabai took revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔曰：「自教匪滋事以來，迫脅良民，焚毀田舍。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, an edict stated: "Since the sect rebels rose, they have forced good people, burned farmsteads,"
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, an edict said sect rebels had forced the people and burned farms.

sentences.zh: 民非甘心從賊，欲逃無歸，歸亦無食。

translations.literal: "The people did not willingly join the rebels; if they fled they had nowhere to go, and if they returned they had nothing to eat."
translations.idiomatic: People did not join willingly; flight brought no refuge and return brought no food.

sentences.zh: 亟宜招撫解散，而非空言所能收效。

translations.literal: "They should quickly be summoned and dispersed—empty words cannot achieve this."
translations.idiomatic: They must be summoned and dispersed quickly; words alone would not suffice.

sentences.zh: 應如何綏輯安插，令勒保詢之劉清及其他良吏，籌議良法，俾可施行，速具以聞。

translations.literal: "How to pacify and settle them should be asked of Le Bao through Liu Qing and other good officials; sound methods should be devised so they can be carried out, and a speedy report made."
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao was to ask Liu Qing and other good officials how to pacify and settle them and report workable methods at once.

sentences.zh: 」甲午，弛私售和闐玉禁。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the ban on private sale of Khotan jade was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the ban on private Khotan jade sales was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，秦承恩以貽誤軍事，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Qin Cheng'en was stripped of office and arrested for dereliction in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Qin Cheng'en lost office and was arrested for military dereliction.

sentences.zh: 李奉翰卒，以費淳為兩江總督。

translations.literal: Li Fenghan died and Fei Chun was made Jiangnan-Jiangxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fenghan died; Fei Chun took the two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復宗室鄉會試例，增部院郎官宗室額缺。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the provincial examination quota for imperial clansmen was restored and additional quota posts for clansmen in ministries were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the clan provincial exam and ministry quota posts for clansmen were restored.

sentences.zh: 壬子，釋回徐述夔、王錫侯子孫緣坐發遣者。

translations.literal: On day renzi, descendants implicated in the cases of Xu Shukui and Wang Xihou who had been banished were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, banished kin of Xu Shukui and Wang Xihou were released.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，錄用故大學士朱軾、孫嘉淦子孫。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, descendants of the late Grand Secretaries Zhu Shi and Sun Jiagan were employed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, descendants of Zhu Shi and Sun Jiagan were given office.

sentences.zh: 三月己未朔，蘇凌阿免，以慶桂為大學士，成德為刑部尚書，傅森為左都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day jiwei: Su Linga was dismissed; Qinggui was made Grand Secretary, Chengde Minister of Punishments, and Fu Sen Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: At the third-month new moon, Su Linga left office; Qinggui joined the Grand Secretariat, Chengde took punishments, and Fu Sen the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 庚申，戶部尚書沈初卒，以范建中為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Minister of Revenue Shen Chu died and Fan Jianzhong was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Shen Chu died; Fan Jianzhong took revenue.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以書麟為閩浙總督、協辨大學士。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Shulin was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and assisting Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Shulin became Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and assisting grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 甲子，調慶霖為福州將軍，福昌為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Qinglin was transferred to Fuzhou general and Fuchang Jiangning general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Qinglin took Fuzhou and Fuchang took Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，許直省道員密摺上奏。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, circuit intendants in Zhili were permitted to submit secret memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Zhili circuit intendants were allowed secret memorials.

sentences.zh: 庚午，解景安任，以倭什布為湖廣總督，吳熊光為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Jing An was relieved and Wushibu made Huguang governor-general and Wu Xiongguang Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Jing An left office; Wushibu took Huguang and Wu Xiongguang Henan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，額勒登保奏剿滅教匪蕭占國、張長更，上嘉之，予二等男。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Eledengbao memorialized the extermination of sect rebels Xiao Zhanguo and Zhang Changgeng; the Emperor praised this and granted him second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Eledengbao reported destroying Xiao Zhanguo and Zhang Changgeng and was made a second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 敘獎裨將朱射斗、楊遇春等。

translations.literal: Commendations were recorded and rewards granted to assistant generals Zhu Shedou, Yang Yuchun, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shedou, Yang Yuchun, and other assistant generals were commended.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，定侍衛軍政。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, regulations were fixed for metropolitan guard military administration.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, metropolitan guard regulations were fixed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，追贈皇四兄履端郡王永<革為>親王，皇七兄悼敏皇子永琮為哲親王，皇十二兄永璣為貝勒。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the fourth imperial brother, Prince of Lüdun Commandery Yongge, was posthumously enfeoffed as prince; the seventh imperial brother, Prince Zhuomin Yongcong, as Prince Zhe; the twelfth imperial brother Yongji as beile.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Prince Yongge was posthumously made a prince, Yongcong Prince Zhe, and Yongji beile.

sentences.zh: 癸未，勒保奏剿滅教匪冷天祿。

translations.literal: On day guwei, Lebao memorialized that sect bandit Leng Tianlu had been exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On guwei, Lebao reported sect leader Leng Tianlu destroyed.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「旬日之內，連翦三酋，深為可嘉，額勒登保晉一等男。

translations.literal: The rescript read: "Within ten days three chieftains were cut down in succession—deeply praiseworthy; E'erdengbao was advanced to baron of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: Rescript: three chiefs fell in ten days—praiseworthy; E'erdengbao was made a first-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 」免河南被匪之鄧州二十州縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes, old and new, were remitted for twenty prefectures and counties including Dengzhou in Henan afflicted by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty Henan districts including Dengzhou lost old and new quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 甘肅布政使廣厚奏剿斃賊目張世龍。

translations.literal: Gansu provincial treasurer Guanghou memorialized that bandit chief Zhang Shilong had been killed in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghou of Gansu reported bandit chief Zhang Shilong killed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑朔，欽天監言四月朔日，日月合璧，五星聯珠。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day jichou: the Directorate of Astronomy reported that on the fourth-month new moon the sun and moon were in conjunction and the five planets in alignment.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth-month new moon, jichou, Astronomy reported sun-moon conjunction and five-planet alignment.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「躔度偶逢，兵戈未息，何足言瑞。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Celestial positions merely happen to coincide; arms have not ceased—how can this be called an omen?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: chance conjunction amid war is no omen.

sentences.zh: 」予尹壯圖給事中，准回籍養親。

translations.literal: Yin Zhuangtu was made supervising censor and permitted to return home to support his parents.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhuangtu became a censor and went home to care for his parents.

sentences.zh: 丙申，恭上大行皇帝尊諡，禮成，頒詔覃恩。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the late emperor's honorific title was reverently submitted; when the rite was complete an edict of grace was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the late emperor received his posthumous title and an amnesty edict followed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免陝西被賊之孝義等三十五廳州縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, old and new quota taxes were remitted for thirty-five subprefectures, prefectures, and counties in Shaanxi including Xiaoyi afflicted by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, thirty-five Shaanxi districts including Xiaoyi lost old and new taxes.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免四川被賊之奉節等三十六廳州縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: On day jihai, old and new quota taxes were remitted for thirty-six subprefectures, prefectures, and counties in Sichuan including Fengjie afflicted by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, thirty-six Sichuan districts including Fengjie lost old and new taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔遵奉皇考敕旨，於庚申、辛酉舉鄉會恩科。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict ordered observance of the late father's instruction to hold special provincial and metropolitan civil examinations in gengshen and xinyou years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, special exams were ordered for gengshen and xinyou per the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賜姚文田等二百二十人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Yao Wentian and two hundred twenty others were granted jinshi and third-place honors with differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Yao Wentian and 220 others received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以慶成為成都將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Qingcheng was made General of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Qingcheng became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午朔，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day wuwu: autumn executions were suspended this year.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon, autumn executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免湖北被賊之孝感等四十七州縣衛新舊額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, old and new quota taxes were remitted for forty-seven prefectures, counties, guards, and posts in Hubei including Xiaogan afflicted by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, forty-seven Hubei districts including Xiaogan lost old and new taxes.

sentences.zh: 庚午，江蘭罷，以初彭齡為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Jiang Lan was dismissed and Chu Pengling made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Jiang Lan was dismissed; Chu Pengling took Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以傅森為兵部尚書，阿迪斯為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Fu Sen was made Minister of War and Adisi Minister of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Fu Sen took War and Adisi the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，克勤郡王恆謹以不謹削爵。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Prince of Lekin Commandery Hengjin was stripped of rank for lack of care.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Prince Hengjin lost his title for negligence.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以董誥為大學士。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Dong Gao was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Dong Gao became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕費淳訪劾貪吏。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Fei Chun was ordered to investigate and impeach corrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Fei Chun was told to expose corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 詔免伯德爾格回民增金錢及葡萄折價。

translations.literal: An edict remitted the Muslim community of Berdelge's additional gold payments and grape valuation.
translations.idiomatic: Berdelge Muslims' extra gold and grape levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，增設步軍統領左右翼總兵官。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou: left and right wing commander posts were added under the Metropolitan Brigade commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jichou, Metropolitan Brigade wing commanders were added.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔曰：「朕聞湖北隨州未被賊擾，因民人掘溝壘山，足資捍禦。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, an edict read: "We have heard that Suizhou in Hubei was not disturbed by bandits because the people dug ditches and piled hills, sufficient for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict praised Suizhou's ditches and hill forts against bandits.

sentences.zh: 民間村堡，侭可照辦。

translations.literal: Village forts among the people may all follow this example.
translations.idiomatic: Village forts may follow the same model.

sentences.zh: 勒保、松筠、吳熊光即曉諭百姓知之。

translations.literal: Lebao, Songyun, and Wu Xiongguang are at once to proclaim this so the people may know.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao, Songyun, and Wu Xiongguang were told to inform the people.

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，吳熊光、吳琠請加徵河工稭料運費銀。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Wu Xiongguang and Wu Tai requested additional collection of silver for river-work straw transport costs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Wu Xiongguang and Wu Tai sought extra river-work transport funds.

sentences.zh: 得旨申飭，下部議處。

translations.literal: The rescript sternly rebuked them and referred the matter to the ministry for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: They were rebuked and the ministry was to decide punishment.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，恤陝西陣亡總兵官保興等世職。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, hereditary offices were granted in condolence to Shaanxi fallen commander Baoxing and others.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, hereditary ranks were granted for Baoxing and other fallen Shaanxi commanders.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，調山西兵三千赴湖北，盛京兵二千，額勒亨額統之，赴四川剿賊。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinyou: three thousand Shanxi troops were transferred to Hubei; two thousand Mukden troops under E'leheng'e were sent to Sichuan to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, xinyou, 3,000 Shanxi troops went to Hubei and 2,000 Mukden troops under E'leheng'e to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，勒保奏獲賊首包正洪，予朱射斗騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Lebao memorialized capture of bandit chief Bao Zhenghong and granted Zhu Shedou the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Lebao reported Bao Zhenghong captured and gave Zhu Shedou a hereditary cavalry command.

sentences.zh: 壬申，經略勒保以玩誤軍務奪職逮問，以明亮為經略，魁倫為四川總督。

translations.literal: On day renshen, pacification commissioner Lebao was stripped of office and arrested for dilatory military conduct; Mingliang was made pacification commissioner and Kuilun Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Lebao was arrested for delay; Mingliang became pacification commissioner and Kuilun Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，削景安伯爵，遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Jing'an's baronage was stripped and he was banished to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Jing'an lost his barony and was sent to Ili.

sentences.zh: 免甘肅被賊隴西等四十八州縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted for forty-eight prefectures and counties in Gansu including Longxi afflicted by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-eight Gansu districts including Longxi lost old and new taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，停中秋節貢。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Mid-Autumn tribute was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Mid-Autumn tribute was halted.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，富俊免，以興奎為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: Fujun was dismissed and Xingkui made Urumchi commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jichou, Fujun was dismissed and Xingkui took Urumchi.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，調盛京兵二千，吉林、黑龍江兵各一千，赴湖北剿賊。

translations.literal: On day renchen, two thousand Mukden troops and one thousand each from Jilin and Heilongjiang were transferred to Hubei to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Mukden, Jilin, and Heilongjiang troops were sent to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以長麟為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Changlin was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Changlin became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙未，勒保奏德楞泰生擒賊目龔文玉，給騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Lebao memorialized that Delengtai had captured bandit chief Gong Wenyu alive and granted a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Lebao reported Gong Wenyu captured alive and granted Delengtai a hereditary cavalry command.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷明亮經略，命額勒登保以都統銜為經略。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Mingliang was dismissed as pacification commissioner and E'erdengbao was ordered to serve as pacification commissioner with the rank of commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Mingliang left the pacification post and E'erdengbao took it as commandant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命修撰趙文楷、中書李鼎元冊封琉球國王尚溫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, compiler Zhao Wenkai and secretary Li Dingyuan were ordered to invest Ryukyu's King Shō On.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhao Wenkai and Li Dingyuan were sent to invest King Shō On of Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，慶成、永保以督軍不力逮問，命那彥成往陝西督辦。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Qingcheng and Yongbao were arrested for ineffective command; Nayancheng was sent to Shaanxi to supervise affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Qingcheng and Yongbao were arrested for poor command; Nayancheng went to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，編修洪亮吉致書成親王私論國政，遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day guichou, compiler Hong Liangji sent a letter to Prince Cheng privately discussing state affairs and was banished to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Hong Liangji was banished to Ili for privately criticizing policy to Prince Cheng.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰朔，恤陣亡貴州副將孫大猷世職。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day bingchen: hereditary offices were granted in condolence to fallen Guizhou deputy commander Sun Dayou.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, bingchen, Sun Dayou received a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，怡親王永琅薨。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Prince Yi Yonglang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Prince Yi Yonglang died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大行梓宮發引，上恭送啟鑾。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the late emperor's coffin departed; the Emperor reverently escorted the departure rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the late emperor's coffin departed and the Emperor escorted it.

sentences.zh: 庚午，葬高宗純皇帝於裕陵。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Emperor Gaozong Chun was buried at Yuling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Emperor Gaozong was buried at Yuling.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，還京。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the court returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the court returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，高宗純皇帝、孝賢純皇后、孝儀純皇后升祔太廟，頒詔覃恩。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Emperor Gaozong Chun, Empress Xiaoxian Chun, and Empress Xiaoyi Chun were enshrined in the Grand Temple and an edict of grace was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Qianlong and his empresses entered the Grand Temple and an amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，故湖廣總督畢沅坐濫用軍需削世職，奪蔭官。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the late Huguang governor-general Bi Yuan was punished for misuse of military supplies by stripping hereditary office and seizing yin privileges.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Bi Yuan lost hereditary rank and yin privileges for misusing military funds.

sentences.zh: 壬午，明亮以剿賊不力罷參贊，褫都統，予副都統剿賊。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Mingliang was dismissed as pacification aide for ineffective suppression, stripped of commandant-in-chief rank, and given vice commandant-in-chief to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Mingliang lost his aide post and commandant rank but kept vice commandant to fight bandits.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，調朱珪為戶部尚書，劉權之為吏部尚書，范建中為左都御史。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renchen: Zhu Gui was transferred to Minister of Revenue, Liu Quanzhi to Minister of Personnel, and Fan Jianzhong to Minister of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, renchen, Zhu Gui took Revenue, Liu Quanzhi Personnel, and Fan Jianzhong the Left.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，明亮奏獲賊首張漢潮。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Mingliang memorialized capture of bandit chief Zhang Hanchao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Mingliang reported Zhang Hanchao captured.

sentences.zh: 湖北道員胡齊侖以侵盜錢糧處斬。

translations.literal: Hubei circuit intendant Hu Qilun was executed for embezzling grain funds.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Qilun of Hubei was executed for embezzling grain funds.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，德楞泰奏獲賊首高均德、高二。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Delengtai memorialized capture of bandit chiefs Gao Junde and Gao Er.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Delengtai reported Gao Junde and Gao Er captured.

sentences.zh: 予德楞泰二等男。

translations.literal: Delengtai was granted baron of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai was made a second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 丁未，成親王永瑆免值軍機處。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Prince Cheng Yongxing was removed from attendance at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Prince Cheng Yongxing left the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 命傅森仍為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Fu Sen was again ordered to serve as Grand Council minister.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Sen returned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命廷臣保舉賢良。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, court ministers were ordered to recommend the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, ministers were told to recommend worthy men.

sentences.zh: 壬子，勒保論斬，解京監候。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Lebao was sentenced to decapitation and sent to the capital for imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Lebao was sentenced to death and held at the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，故超勇公海蘭察子公安祿於四川剿賊陣亡，詔優恤之，名其子恩特赫默紥拉芬，襲超勇公。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: because Anlu, son of the late Duke Chaoyong Hai Lancha, died suppressing bandits in Sichuan, he was specially condoled; his son was named Entehemozhafen and inherited the dukedom of Chaoyong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiazi, Anlu was condoled for dying in Sichuan; his son Entehemozhafen inherited Chaoyong.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免直隸積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, accumulated tax arrears in Zhili were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Zhili's accumulated tax arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，興肇、慶成以帶兵不力遣戍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Xingzhao and Qingcheng were banished for ineffective troop command.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Xingzhao and Qingcheng were banished for poor command.

sentences.zh: 賞額勒登保銀一萬兩，德楞泰銀五千兩。

translations.literal: E'erdengbao was rewarded with ten thousand taels of silver and Delengtai with five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: E'erdengbao received 10,000 taels and Delengtai 5,000.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，冬至，祀天於圜丘，奉高宗純皇帝配享，頒詔覃恩。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, at the winter solstice Heaven was sacrificed at the Circular Mound Altar with Emperor Gaozong Chun as associate; an edict of grace was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, winter solstice sacrifice paired Gaozong and brought an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，漕運總督蔣兆奎以率請加賦濟運罷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: grain-transport governor-general Jiang Zhaoqian was dismissed for leading a petition to raise taxes to fund transport.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, renchen, Jiang Zhaoqian was dismissed for seeking a transport tax increase.

sentences.zh: 恤陣亡副將丁有成、德亮等世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary offices were granted in condolence to fallen deputy commanders Ding Youcheng, Deliang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary ranks were granted for Ding Youcheng, Deliang, and other fallen deputies.

sentences.zh: 甲午，福寧以殺降報捷，景安以縱賊殃民，俱褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Funing was stripped and arrested for reporting victory after killing surrenderers; Jing'an for letting bandits harm the people—both were dismissed and arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Funing and Jing'an were arrested for false victory and letting bandits ravage the people.

sentences.zh: 丙申，額勒登保奏獲教匪王登廷。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, E'erdengbao memorialized capture of sect bandit Wang Dengting.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, E'erdengbao reported Wang Dengting captured.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，姜晟奏獲湖南苗匪吳陳受。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Jiang Sheng memorialized capture of Hunan Miao bandit Wu Chenshou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Jiang Sheng reported Miao chief Wu Chenshou captured.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎，加太子少保。

translations.literal: The rescript commended him and advanced him to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was commended and made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 壬子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the seasonal enshrinement rite was performed at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Grand Temple seasonal rite was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免河南、湖北被兵六十七州縣新舊額賦，徵兵經過直隸、河南、湖北田賦。

translations.literal: This year, old and new quota taxes were remitted for sixty-seven prefectures and counties in Henan and Hubei afflicted by troops, and land taxes were levied in Zhili, Henan, and Hubei through which troops passed.
translations.idiomatic: This year, sixty-seven Henan and Hubei war districts lost taxes while march routes were taxed.

sentences.zh: 又除江蘇、湖北各一縣坍田額賦，吉林三姓、黑龍江、雲南石屏州災賦。

translations.literal: Taxes on collapsed fields were also remitted for one county each in Jiangsu and Hubei, and disaster taxes in Jilin Sanxing, Heilongjiang, and Yunnan Shiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Collapsed-field taxes in one Jiangsu and one Hubei county and disaster taxes in Jilin, Heilongjiang, and Shiping were remitted.

sentences.zh: 普免天下積年逋賦。

translations.literal: Accumulated tax arrears empire-wide were generally remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Empire-wide accumulated tax arrears were generally remitted.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Siam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年庚申春正月甲寅朔，上謁陵。

translations.literal: Fifth year, gengshen, spring, first month, new moon on day jiayin: the Emperor worshipped at the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5, on the first-month new moon, jiayin, the Emperor worshipped at the tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詣裕陵行初期祭禮。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, he went to Yuling to perform the initial mourning sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, he sacrificed at Yuling in initial mourning.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命額勒登保剿辦陝西教匪，德楞泰、魁倫剿辦四川教匪。

translations.literal: E'erdengbao was ordered to suppress Shaanxi sect bandits; Delengtai and Kuilun to suppress Sichuan sect bandits.
translations.idiomatic: E'erdengbao took Shaanxi sect bandits; Delengtai and Kuilun, Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以松筠為伊犁將軍，仍留陝西剿賊。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Songyun was made Ili general while remaining in Shaanxi to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Songyun became Ili general but stayed in Shaanxi against bandits.

sentences.zh: 調長麟為陝甘總督，以玉德為閩浙總督，阮元為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Changlin was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general; Yu De was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Ruan Yuan Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Changlin took Shaanxi-Gansu; Yu De, Fujian-Zhejiang; Ruan Yuan, Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔清查庫款，從容彌補，勿以嚴急而致累民。

translations.literal: On day renxu, an edict ordered investigation of treasury funds to be made up at a measured pace and not so harshly as to burden the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, treasury shortfalls were to be made up gradually without harming the people.

sentences.zh: 金士松卒，以張若渟為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Jin Shisong died and Zhang Ruoting was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shisong died; Zhang Ruoting took War.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祈穀於上帝，奉高宗純皇帝配享。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, prayer for grain was offered to the Supreme Lord with Emperor Gaozong Chun as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, grain prayer paired Emperor Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 解倭什布任，以姜晟為湖廣總督，移松筠剿湖北賊。

translations.literal: Wo-shi-bu was relieved; Jiang Sheng was made Huguang governor-general and Songyun was shifted to suppress Hubei bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Wo-shi-bu was dismissed; Jiang Sheng took Huguang and Songyun fought Hubei bandits.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以景熠為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Jingyi was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Jingyi became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，命那彥成參贊甘肅軍務。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: Nayancheng was ordered to assist in Gansu military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dinghai, Nayancheng was ordered to assist Gansu forces.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以汪承霈為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Wang Chengpei was made Minister of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Wang Chengpei took the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，敕新疆鑄乾隆錢。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Xinjiang was ordered to cast Qianlong coin.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Xinjiang was ordered to cast Qianlong cash.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，恤四川陣亡副將關聯升等世職。

translations.literal: On day renyin, hereditary offices were granted in condolence to fallen Sichuan deputy commander Guan Liansheng and others.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, hereditary ranks were granted for Guan Liansheng and other fallen Sichuan deputies.

sentences.zh: 丁未，追論縱賊諸臣，秦承恩、宜綿戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, officials who had let bandits escape were reviewed; Qin Chengen and Yimian were banished to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Qin Chengen and Yimian were sent to Ili for letting bandits escape.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，予告大學士蔡新卒。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, retired Grand Secretary Cai Xin died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, retired Grand Secretary Cai Xin died.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，上謁陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen: the Emperor worshipped at the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, gengshen, the Emperor worshipped at the tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，解七十五任，逮京治罪。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Qishiwu was relieved of office and summoned to the capital for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Qishiwu was dismissed and sent to the capital for trial.

sentences.zh: 甲子，清明節，上行敷土禮。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, at the Qingming Festival the Emperor performed the spreading-earth rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Qingming, the Emperor performed the spreading-earth rite.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，阿迪斯以擁兵玩誤逮問，起勒保護成都將軍。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Adisi was arrested for holding troops in dilatory neglect; Lebao was restored and made General of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Adisi was arrested for delay; Lebao was restored as Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor went to the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Emperor went to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰奏截剿渡江教匪，獲匪首冉添元，晉三等子。

translations.literal: Delengtai memorialized intercepting teaching-bandits crossing the river, capturing bandit chief Ran Tianyuan; he was advanced to third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai reported intercepting river-crossing sect rebels and capturing Ran Tianyuan; he was made a third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor went to worship at the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，還京。

translations.literal: On day yihai, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，甄錄賢良祠大臣後裔。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, descendants of ministers in the Hall of Worthies were selected and enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, descendants of Hall of Worthies ministers were enrolled.

sentences.zh: 以縱賊渡嘉陵江，復過潼河，奪魁倫職逮問。

translations.literal: For allowing bandits to cross the Jialing and again pass the Tong River, Kuilun was stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilun lost office and was arrested for letting rebels cross the Jialing and Tong.

sentences.zh: 以勒保署四川總督，起明亮藍翎侍衛從軍。

translations.literal: Lebao was made acting Sichuan governor-general; Mingliang, a Blue Bordered Banner imperial bodyguard, was called up to follow the army.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao acted as Sichuan governor-general and Mingliang joined the campaign as an imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未朔，日有食之，乙酉，阿迪斯遣戍伊犁，以德楞泰為成都將軍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day guiwei: there was a solar eclipse; on day yiyou, Addis was banished to Yili; Delengtai was made Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: At the fourth-month new moon, guiwei, there was an eclipse; on yiyou, Addis went to Yili and Delengtai became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 庚子，雲南裸夷平，加書麟太子太保。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yunnan's Luo Yi were pacified; Shulin was advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yunnan's Luo Yi were pacified and Shulin became Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 閏四月甲寅，命刑部查久禁官犯及禁錮子孫與久戍者寬減之。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day jiayin: the Board of Punishments was ordered to review long-imprisoned official convicts, perpetually confined descendants, and long-exiled men for lenient reduction.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the intercalary fourth month, the Board of Punishments was to review long-held prisoners for leniency.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上步禱祈雨。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor walked in prayer for rain.
