translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor prayed on foot for rain.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，釋洪亮吉回籍。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Hong Liangji was released to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Hong Liangji was released to his native place.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，釋安南人黎屌等於獄，安置火器營，給月餼。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Annamese Li Diao and others were released from prison, settled in the Firearms Brigade, and given monthly rations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Li Diao and other Annamese prisoners were freed, settled in the Firearms Brigade, and given rations.

sentences.zh: 是日，雨。

translations.literal: That day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，恤四川陣亡提督達三泰世職。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, hereditary office was granted for Sichuan battle-death Regional Commander Da Santai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Da Santai of Sichuan received a hereditary office for dying in battle.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以那彥成不任戎務，罷直軍機處，召回京。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, because Nayancheng was unfit for military affairs, he was removed from the Grand Council and recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Nayancheng left the Grand Council and was recalled for military incompetence.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌朔，夏至，祀地於方澤，奉高宗純皇帝配享。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day renxu: at the summer solstice, Earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound, with the Gaozong Chun Emperor as collateral spirit.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth-month new moon, renxu, the summer solstice Square Mound rite paired the Gaozong Chun Emperor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，經略額勒登保以剿辦匪目劉允恭等功，晉三等子。

translations.literal: On day jichou, campaign commander Eledengbao was advanced to third-class viscount for suppressing bandit leaders Liu Yungong and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Eledengbao became a third-class viscount for suppressing Liu Yungong and others.

sentences.zh: 丙午，那彥成到京，奏對無狀，降為翰林院侍講。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Nayancheng reached the capital; his memorial audience was unsatisfactory; he was demoted to Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Nayancheng reached Beijing, failed at audience, and was demoted to Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，額勒登保奏獲賊首楊開甲。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renxu: Eledengbao memorialized capture of bandit chief Yang Kaijia.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, renxu, Eledengbao reported capturing Yang Kaijia.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以張若渟為刑部尚書，汪承霈為兵部尚書，馮光熊為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Zhang Ruoting was made Minister of Punishments, Wang Chengpei Minister of War, and Feng Guangxiong Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Zhang Ruoting took punishments, Wang Chengpei war, and Feng Guangxiong the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賜魁倫自盡，戍其子紥拉芬於伊犁。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Kuilun was granted suicide; his son Zhala Fen was banished to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Kuilun was ordered to take his own life and his son Zhala Fen was sent to Yili.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，命右翼總兵長齡統吉林、黑龍江兵赴湖北協剿教匪。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinmao: Right Wing regional commander Changling was ordered to lead Jilin and Heilongjiang troops to Hubei to assist in suppressing teaching-bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, xinmao, Changling was sent with Jilin and Heilongjiang troops to help suppress Hubei sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 琅玕奏青苗楊文泰作亂，剿平之。

translations.literal: Langgan memorialized that Qingmiao Yang Wentai had rebelled; it was suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Langgan reported Yang Wentai's Qingmiao rebellion suppressed.

sentences.zh: 馬慧裕奏獲傳教首犯劉之協，解京誅之。

translations.literal: Ma Huiyu memorialized capture of chief sect teacher Liu Zhixie; he was sent to the capital and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Huiyu sent captured sect chief Liu Zhixie to Beijing for execution.

sentences.zh: 丙申，禮部尚書德明卒，以達椿為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Minister of Rites Deming died; Dachun was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Deming died and Dachun took the rites ministry.

sentences.zh: 己酉，額勒登保奏獲賊目陳傑。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Eledengbao memorialized capture of bandit leader Chen Jie.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Eledengbao reported Chen Jie captured.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，固原提督王文雄剿賊陣亡，予三等子。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingchen: Guyuan regional commander Wang Wenxiong died in battle suppressing bandits; he was granted third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, bingchen, Wang Wenxiong died fighting bandits and received a third-class viscountage.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu: the Emperor went to worship at the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, renwu, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 戊子，還京。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，恤四川陣亡副將李錫命世職。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, hereditary office was granted for Sichuan battle-death Vice Commander Li Ximing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Li Ximing of Sichuan received a hereditary office for dying in battle.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，胡季堂卒，以姜晟為直隸總督，書麟為湖廣總督，琅玕為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: Hu Jitang died; Jiang Sheng was made Zhili governor-general, Shulin Huguang governor-general, and Langgan Yungui governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuchen, Hu Jitang died; Jiang Sheng took Zhili, Shulin Huguang, and Langgan Yungui.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，睿親王淳穎薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou: Prince Rui Chunying died.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, yiyou, Prince Rui Chunying died.

sentences.zh: 己亥，恤陣亡革職將軍富成等世職。

translations.literal: On day jihai, hereditary offices were granted for battle-death dismissed-general Fucheng and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Fucheng and other dismissed generals who died in battle received hereditary offices.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，陝西教匪徐添德竄湖北，湖北教匪冉學勝竄陝西，降責德楞泰、勒保等。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiayin: Shaanxi teaching-bandit Xu Tiande fled into Hubei, and Hubei teaching-bandit Ran Xuesheng fled into Shaanxi; Delengtai, Lebao, and others were demoted and rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in month 12, Xu Tiande fled into Hubei and Ran Xuesheng into Shaanxi; Delengtai and Lebao were demoted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，德楞泰奏獲教匪楊開第等。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Delengtai memorialized capture of teaching-bandits Yang Kaidi and others.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Delengtai reported Yang Kaidi and other sect rebels captured.

sentences.zh: 丙子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the autumnal ceremony at the Imperial Ancestral Temple was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the autumnal temple rite was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免順天、江蘇、四川、雲南、甘肅等省七十廳州縣災賦，及兵差經過、坍田額賦各有差。

translations.literal: This year, disaster land tax was remitted in seventy prefectures, departments, and counties of Shuntian, Jiangsu, Sichuan, Yunnan, Gansu, and elsewhere, and transit and collapsed-field quotas were remitted by degree where troops passed.
translations.idiomatic: This year disaster taxes were forgiven in seventy districts across Shuntian, Jiangsu, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Gansu, with other remissions where troops passed.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年辛酉春正月壬午，以傅森為戶部尚書，明安為步軍統領。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day renwu: Fusen was made Minister of Revenue and Ming'an metropolitan banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, first month, renwu, Fusen took revenue and Ming'an became metropolitan banner commander.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣少卿窩星阿、裘行簡犒額勒登保、德楞泰軍。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Junior Minister Woxing'a and Qiu Xingjian were dispatched to reward the armies of Eledengbao and Delengtai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Woxing'a and Qiu Xingjian were sent to reward Eledengbao's and Delengtai's armies.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，德楞泰以剿山陽教匪功，復一等子。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, for suppressing teaching-bandits in Shanyang, Delengtai was restored to first-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Delengtai was restored to first-class viscount for suppressing Shanyang sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，德楞泰奏獲賊首高二、王儒。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Delengtai memorialized capture of bandit chiefs Gao Er and Wang Ru.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Delengtai reported Gao Er and Wang Ru captured.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，勒保奏獲黃、藍、白三號賊目徐萬富等。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Lebao memorialized capture of yellow, blue, and white numbered bandit leaders Xu Wanfu and others.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Lebao reported Xu Wanfu and other yellow, blue, and white bandit leaders captured.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，勒保奏獲賊首王士虎。

translations.literal: Second month, day yimao: Lebao memorialized capture of bandit chief Wang Shihu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, yimao, Lebao reported Wang Shihu captured.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，書麟奏明亮獲賊目卜興昂。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Shulin memorialized that Mingliang had captured bandit leader Bu Xing'ang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Shulin reported Mingliang had captured Bu Xing'ang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜賢良後裔尚書魏象樞六世孫煜、尚書楊名時曾孫景曾、巡撫徐士林孫從旭舉人。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, descendants of worthies were granted juren: Minister Wei Xiangqi's sixth-generation descendant Yu, Minister Yang Mingshi's great-great-grandson Jingzeng, and Provincial Governor Xu Shilin's grandson Congxu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Yu, Jingzeng, and Congxu of worthy lineages received juren degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上謁陵，行敷土禮。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor went to worship at the tombs and performed the spreading-earth rite.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor visited the tombs and performed the spreading-earth rite.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 改湖廣提督為湖南提督。

translations.literal: The Huguang regional commander was changed to Hunan regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang regional command became the Hunan regional command.

sentences.zh: 置湖北提督，駐襄陽。

translations.literal: A Hubei regional commander was established, stationed at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: A Hubei regional commander was posted at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 改襄陽鎮總兵為鄖陽鎮總兵。

translations.literal: The Xiangyang garrison regional commander was changed to Yunyang garrison regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiangyang garrison command became the Yunyang garrison command.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，傅森卒，以成德為戶部尚書、軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Fusen died; Chengde was made Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Fusen died; Chengde took revenue and joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，額勒登保奏獲賊首王廷詔。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Eledengbao memorialized capture of bandit chief Wang Tingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Eledengbao reported Wang Tingzhao captured.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，詔：「被賊裹脅匪徒多系良民，凡投出者悉貸其死。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengchen, edict: "Many who were coerced by bandits are good commoners; all who surrender shall have death forgiven."
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in month 3, an edict spared death for coerced followers who surrendered.

sentences.zh: 軍前大臣仰體朕意，廣為宣示，務使周知。

translations.literal: "Field ministers before the army are to carry out My intent, proclaim it widely, and ensure all know."
translations.idiomatic: Field ministers were to proclaim the edict widely before the army.

sentences.zh: 」恤陣亡總兵多爾濟紥布、李紹祖等世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary offices were granted for battle-death regional commanders Dorjinzhab, Li Shaozu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Dorjinzhab, Li Shaozu, and other fallen regional commanders received hereditary offices.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜賢良後裔大學士李光地四世孫維翰、尚書湯斌四世孫念曾舉人，巡撫傅弘烈六世孫縣丞徵瓏知縣。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, descendants of worthies were granted: juren to Grand Secretary Li Guangdi's fourth-generation descendant Weihan and Minister Tang Bin's fourth-generation descendant Nianzeng; county magistrate to Provincial Governor Fu Honglie's sixth-generation descendant Zhenglong, formerly assistant county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Weihan and Nianzeng received juren and Zhenglong became county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔：「朕將謁陵，春苗申昜發，令大臣監護民田，勿許踐踏禾苗。

translations.literal: On day jihai, edict: "I am about to go to worship at the tombs; spring seedlings are sprouting—ministers are ordered to guard the people's fields and not permit trampling the grain."
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, an edict ordered ministers to guard crops during the tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 」敘江西士民協剿教匪劉聯登功，改江西寧州為義寧州。

translations.literal: Merit was recorded for Jiangxi gentry and people who assisted in suppressing teaching-bandit Liu Liandeng; Jiangxi Ningzhou was renamed Yiningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi merit was recorded for helping suppress Liu Liandeng, and Ningzhou was renamed Yiningzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor went to worship at the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，行釋服禮。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the mourning-garment ritual was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the mourning-garment rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未朔，上還京。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day dingwei: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the fourth-month new moon, dingwei, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己未，以四川民人輸資急公，免遂寧等八十六廳州縣明年額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, because Sichuan people had contributed funds urgently for public service, next year's quota tax was remitted for eighty-six prefectures, departments, and counties including Suining.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, eighty-six Sichuan districts including Suining were forgiven next year's tax for public contributions.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，冊立皇后鈕祜祿氏。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Empress Niohuru was installed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Empress Niohuru was enthroned.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，協辦大學士、湖廣總督書麟卒，以吳熊光為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Associate Grand Secretary and Huguang Governor-General Shulin died; Wu Xiongguang was made Huguang Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Shulin died; Wu Xiongguang took Huguang.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰奏獲賊首張允壽。

translations.literal: Delengtai memorialized capture of bandit chief Zhang Yunshou.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai reported Zhang Yunshou captured.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以獲王廷詔、高二、馬五功，晉額勒登保二等子，楊遇春騎都尉。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, for capturing Wang Tingzhao, Gao Er, and Ma Wu, Eledengbao was advanced to second-class viscount and Yang Yuchun Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, capturing Wang Tingzhao, Gao Er, and Ma Wu brought Eledengbao a second-class viscountage and Yang Yuchun cavalry commandant rank.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以兩廣總督吉慶協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Liang-Guang Governor-General Jiqing was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Jiqing of Liang-Guang became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜顧皋等二百七十五人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Gu Gao and 275 others were granted jinshi with differences in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Gu Gao and 275 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，賜賢良後裔大學士王熙曾孫元洪舉人。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jimao: Wang Xi's great-great-grandson Yuan Hong of worthy descendants was granted juren.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jimao, Yuan Hong of Wang Xi's line received juren.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上祭文昌廟，始命列入祀典。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor sacrificed at the Wenchang Temple; it was first ordered entered in the sacrificial register.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor sacrificed at Wenchang Temple, newly added to the register.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，恤四川陣亡總兵朱射斗視提督，予世職。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Sichuan battle-death regional commander Zhu Shedou was treated as regional commander in condolences; hereditary office was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Zhu Shedou of Sichuan was mourned as a regional commander and given a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命總兵官輪班人覲。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, regional commanders were ordered to attend audience in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, regional commanders were ordered to rotate capital audiences.

sentences.zh: 奉天府丞視學政，三年更任。

translations.literal: The Fengtian prefectural vice prefect served as education intendant, changed every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian's vice prefect served as education intendant on a three-year rotation.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以額勒登保為理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Eledengbao was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Eledengbao became minister of colonial affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，大雨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, renzi, heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 永定河決，分遣卿員撫恤被水災民。

translations.literal: The Yongding River burst; ministers were dispatched to comfort flood victims.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River broke its banks and ministers were sent to comfort flood victims.

sentences.zh: 以水災停本年秋獮。

translations.literal: Because of flood disaster, the autumn hunt of this year was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: This year's autumn hunt was canceled because of flooding.

sentences.zh: 姜晟免，發永定河效力。

translations.literal: Jiang Sheng was dismissed and sent to serve at the Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Sheng was dismissed and sent to the Yongding River project.

sentences.zh: 起陳大文署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Chen Dawen was called up as acting Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dawen was called up to act as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，復雨。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, rain fell again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, rain fell again.

sentences.zh: 西安將軍恆瑞卒。

translations.literal: Xi'an general Heng Rui died.
translations.idiomatic: Heng Rui, Xi'an general, died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上步禱社稷壇祈晴。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor walked in prayer at the Altar of Soil and Grain for clear weather.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor prayed on foot at the Altar of Soil and Grain for sun.

sentences.zh: 是日，晴。

translations.literal: That day it cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The sky cleared that day.

sentences.zh: 勒保奏東鄉青、藍號匪悉數殲除。

translations.literal: Lebao memorialized that eastern-route green and blue numbered bandits were entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao reported eastern green and blue bandit bands entirely destroyed.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰，特發在京兵丁口糧一月。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengchen: grain rations for one month were specially issued to capital garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, gengchen, capital garrison troops received a special month's grain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命那彥寶、巴寧阿修築永定河工。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Nayanchenbao and Baining'a were ordered to repair Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Nayanchenbao and Baining'a were ordered to repair the Yongding River.

sentences.zh: 勒保奏獲匪目徐添壽、王登高。

translations.literal: Lebao memorialized capture of bandit leaders Xu Tianshou and Wang Denggao.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao reported Xu Tianshou and Wang Denggao captured.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賑熱河水災。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Rehe flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Rehe flood victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，額勒登保奏獲匪首王士虎、冉添泗。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingsi: Eledengbao memorialized capture of bandit chiefs Wang Shihu and Ran Tiansi.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, dingsi, Eledengbao reported Wang Shihu and Ran Tiansi captured.

sentences.zh: 勒保奏七十五獲賊目劉清選、湯步武等。

translations.literal: Lebao memorialized that Qishiwu had captured bandit leaders Liu Qingxuan, Tang Buwu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao reported Qishiwu had captured Liu Qingxuan, Tang Buwu, and others.

sentences.zh: 甲子，勒保奏獲賊首冉學勝等，封三等男。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Lebao memorialized capture of bandit chief Ran Xuesheng and others; he was enfeoffed as third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Lebao reported Ran Xuesheng captured and was made a third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，續修大清會典。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jichou: the Great Qing Collected Statutes were continued in revision.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, jichou, revision of the Great Qing Collected Statutes continued.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，永定河合龍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: the Yongding River was joined and closed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, bingwu, the Yongding River closure was completed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，額勒登保奏獲賊首辛斗。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Eledengbao memorialized capture of bandit chief Xin Dou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Eledengbao reported Xin Dou captured.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰奏斃賊首龍紹周。

translations.literal: Delengtai memorialized that bandit chief Long Shaozhou was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai reported Long Shaozhou killed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔甄敘川、陝軍勞，晉額勒登保三等伯，德楞泰二等伯，賽沖阿騎都尉，溫春雲騎尉。

translations.literal: On day guihai, an edict recorded merit for Sichuan and Shaanxi armies; Eledengbao was advanced to third-class earl, Delengtai to second-class earl, Saichong'a Commandant of Cavalry, and Wenchun Cloud-Rider Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Sichuan and Shaanxi merit brought Eledengbao a third-class earldom, Delengtai a second-class earldom, and rewards for Saichong'a and Wenchun.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，貴州巡撫伊桑阿以驕黷欺罔賜死。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen: Guizhou Governor Yisang'a was granted death for arrogance, depravity, and deceit.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiashen, Guizhou Governor Yisang'a was ordered to die for arrogance and deceit.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔曰：「軍務即日告蕆，安插鄉勇為善後要事。

translations.literal: On day guisi, edict: "Military affairs will soon be concluded; settling the local braves is an essential follow-up matter."
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, an edict said military affairs would soon end and local braves must be settled.

sentences.zh: 其通籌詳議以聞。

translations.literal: "Take comprehensive counsel in detail and report."
translations.idiomatic: Ministers were to plan settlement in detail and report.

sentences.zh: 」乙未，額勒登保奏獲賊首高見奇。

translations.literal: " On day yiwei, Eledengbao memorialized capture of bandit chief Gao Jianqi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Eledengbao reported bandit chief Gao Jianqi captured.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，七十五以縱賊，奪職逮問。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Qishiwu, for allowing bandits to escape, was stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Qishiwu was dismissed and arrested for letting bandits escape.

sentences.zh: 己亥，升四川達州為綏定府，太平營為太平協。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Sichuan's Dazhou was promoted to Suiding Prefecture and Taiping Camp to Taiping Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Dazhou became Suiding Prefecture and Taiping Camp, Taiping Brigade.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，慶成奏獲苟文明股匪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day guimao: Qingcheng memorialized capture of Gou Wenming's band of rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, guimao new moon, Qingcheng reported Gou Wenming's faction captured.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔曰：「前奉皇考特旨，查考本朝殉節諸臣未得世職者，業經查出一百四十餘員，補給恩騎尉世職。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, an edict said: "Previously, by special order of my late father the Emperor, officials of this dynasty who died steadfastly for the state but had not received hereditary offices were investigated; more than one hundred forty persons were already found and granted the hereditary Enjiwei office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, an edict said Hongli had ordered martyrs without hereditary rank found; over 140 received Enjiwei.

sentences.zh: 茲又續查得九百九十餘員，開單呈覽，均系抗節效忠之臣。

translations.literal: Now a further search has found more than nine hundred ninety persons; a list has been submitted for review; all are ministers who resisted unto death and served with loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Another 990 martyrs were listed; all had resisted to the death in loyal service.

sentences.zh: 其子孫俱即給與恩騎尉世職，支給俸饟。

translations.literal: Their descendants are all immediately granted the hereditary Enjiwei office, with stipends paid.
translations.idiomatic: Their descendants immediately received Enjiwei rank and stipends.

sentences.zh: 除投標當差外，有原應試者，准作文武生員，一體應試。

translations.literal: Apart from registering for corvée assignments, those who were originally examination candidates may sit for civil or military licentiate examinations and compete on the same footing.
translations.idiomatic: Besides corvée registration, former candidates might take civil or military licentiate exams.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，詔獎劉清，特授四川建昌道。

translations.literal: " On day guihai, an edict praised Liu Qing, who was specially appointed Sichuan Jiancheng intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Liu Qing was praised and specially made Sichuan Jiancheng intendant.

sentences.zh: 壬申，額勒登保奏剿辦通江賊匪，斃匪目苟朝獻。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Eledengbao memorialized that in suppressing Tongjiang bandits he had killed the rebel leader Gou Chaoxian.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Eledengbao reported killing Tongjiang rebel chief Gou Chaoxian.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the joint seasonal sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor performed the joint ancestral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山西、浙江、安徽、四川、雲南、甘肅等省二百三十一廳州縣衛額賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, quota land tax was remitted by varying amounts for 231 subprefectures, prefectures, counties, and guards in Zhili, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Anhui, Sichuan, Yunnan, Gansu, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, 231 districts in seven provinces and more lost quota tax by degree.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年壬戌春正月癸酉朔，上謁裕陵，行三期祭禮。

translations.literal: Seventh year, renxu year, spring, first month, new moon on day guiyou: the Emperor visited Yuling and performed the third-period mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7, guiyou new moon, the Emperor visited Yuling for third-period mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 賜所過貧民棉衣。

translations.literal: Cotton coats were bestowed on poor people in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: Poor people along the route received cotton coats.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，定祭社稷壇用上戊。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, sacrifice at the altars of soil and grain was fixed to use the upper wu day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, soil-and-grain sacrifice was set on the upper wu day.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上還京。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以松筠為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Songyun was made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Songyun became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 甲午，額勒登保奏獲首逆辛聰，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Eledengbao memorialized capture of chief rebel Xin Cong; the remaining faction was wholly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Eledengbao reported chief rebel Xin Cong captured and the rest pacified.

sentences.zh: 吳熊光奏獲匪首張允壽子得貴，撲滅藍號賊股。

translations.literal: Wu Xiongguang memorialized capture of bandit chief Zhang Yunshou's son Degui and annihilation of the Blue Faction rebel band.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xiongguang reported Zhang Yunshou's son Degui captured and the Blue Faction band destroyed.

sentences.zh: 明安以貪黷褫職，遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Ming'an was stripped of office for corruption and sent into exile at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'an was dismissed for graft and banished to Ili.

sentences.zh: 以祿康為步軍統領，解刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Lukang was made metropolitan gendarmerie commander and relieved of Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Lukang took the metropolitan gendarmerie and left punishments.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保以疏防苟文明竄渡漢江，降男爵。

translations.literal: Eledengbao, for lax defense allowing Gou Wenming to slip across the Han River, was demoted to baron.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao was demoted to baron after Gou Wenming crossed the Han.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，以苟文明竄南山老林，飭領兵大臣堵剿，地方官嚴密查拏，勿令蔓延。

translations.literal: Second month, day guimao: because Gou Wenming had slipped into the old forests of the southern mountains, leading generals on the frontier were ordered to block and suppress him and local officials were to search and seize strictly, that he not spread further.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, guimao, Gou Wenming in southern mountain forests drew orders to block him and tighten local searches.

sentences.zh: 丁未，釋奠先師孔子。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the sacrifice to Confucius was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor sacrificed to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，優恤陣亡副將韓自昌與其弟副將韓加業，飭地方官為建雙烈祠，賜其母銀三百兩。

translations.literal: On day renxu, posthumous favor was extended to Deputy General Han Zichang, who fell in battle, and his younger brother Deputy General Han Jiaye; local officials were ordered to build a shrine to both martyrs and three hundred taels of silver were granted their mother.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, fallen Deputy General Han Zichang and his brother Han Jiaye won a dual martyr shrine and three hundred taels for their mother.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，額勒登保奏劉清獲賊首李彬、辛文，加按察使銜花翎。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Eledengbao memorialized that Liu Qing had captured bandit chiefs Li Bin and Xin Wen; he was given censorial intendant rank with a peacock tail.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Liu Qing captured chiefs Li Bin and Xin Wen and gained censor-intendant rank with a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，勒保奏獲賊首張添倫、魏學盛、陳國珠。

translations.literal: Third month, day guiyou: Lebao memorialized capture of bandit chiefs Zhang Tianlun, Wei Xuesheng, and Chen Guozhu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, guiyou, Lebao reported chiefs Zhang Tianlun, Wei Xuesheng, and Chen Guozhu captured.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，德楞泰奏獲匪首龔其堯、李世漢、李國珍，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Delengtai memorialized capture of rebel chiefs Gong Qiyao, Li Shihan, and Li Guozhen; the remaining rebels were wholly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Delengtai reported Gong Qiyao, Li Shihan, and Li Guozhen captured and the rest pacified.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor went to worship at the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor went to the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，還京。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，成德卒，以祿康為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Cheng De died; Lukang was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Cheng De died and Lukang took revenue.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，以顏檢為直隸總督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen: Yan Jian was made Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, wushen, Yan Jian became Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜吳廷琛等二百四十八人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Wu Tingchen and 248 others were granted jinshi and other examination degrees by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Wu Tingchen and 248 others received jinshi and related degrees.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，慶成奏獲賊首魏洪升、張喜、白庸。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Qingcheng memorialized capture of bandit chiefs Wei Hongsheng, Zhang Xi, and Bai Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Qingcheng reported chiefs Wei Hongsheng, Zhang Xi, and Bai Yong captured.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，睿親王寶恩薨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jimao: Prince Ruqin Baoen died.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jimao, Prince Ruqin Baoen died.

sentences.zh: 琅玕奏獲裸匪首逆臘者布。

translations.literal: Langgan memorialized capture of the Luo bandit chief rebel Lazhebu.
translations.idiomatic: Langgan reported the Luo bandit chief rebel Lazhebu captured.

sentences.zh: 壬午，勒保奏獲匪首庹向瑤、徐添陪、張思從。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Lebao memorialized capture of rebel chiefs Tuo Xiangyao, Xu Tianpei, and Zhang Sicong.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Lebao reported chiefs Tuo Xiangyao, Xu Tianpei, and Zhang Sicong captured.

sentences.zh: 甲午，慶成奏搜捕餘匪，獲康二麻、張昌元，加太子太保。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Qingcheng memorialized that in searching out remaining bandits he had captured Kang Ermo and Zhang Changyuan; he was promoted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Qingcheng reported Kang Ermo and Zhang Changyuan taken and was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，德楞泰奏教匪樊人傑溺水死，俘其妻孥，餘匪殲盡，晉封三等侯。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: Delengtai memorialized that the teaching-bandit Fan Renjie drowned and his wife and children were captured; the remaining bandits were annihilated; he was enfeoffed third-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jiyou, Delengtai reported Fan Renjie drowned, his family captured, the rest destroyed, and became a third-class marquis.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命劉權之、德瑛為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Liu Quanzhi and De Ying were made Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Liu Quanzhi and De Ying joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，達椿卒，以長麟為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Dachun died; Chang Lin was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Dachun died and Chang Lin took rites.

sentences.zh: 命保寧管理兵部。

translations.literal: Baoning was ordered to administer the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Baoning was ordered to run the war ministry.

sentences.zh: 以祿康、恭阿拉為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Lukang and Gong'ala were made Chinese Banner commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Lukang and Gong'ala took the Chinese Banner commands.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，勒保奏剿殲黃、白、青、藍四號賊匪，晉一等男。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinwei: Lebao memorialized annihilation of Yellow, White, Green, and Blue Faction teaching bandits; he was enfeoffed first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, xinwei, Lebao reported Yellow, White, Green, and Blue factions destroyed and became a first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，陝西貢生何泰條陳黜奢崇儉，挽迴風氣。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Shaanxi tribute student He Tai memorialized urging rejection of luxury and honoring thrift to restore public morals.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Shaanxi student He Tai urged thrift to restore morals.

sentences.zh: 得旨可采，賞大緞二匹。

translations.literal: Receiving the rescript, it was deemed adoptable; two bolts of fine satin were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was accepted and he received two bolts of fine satin.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大學士王傑致仕，加太子太傅，在籍食俸。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Grand Secretary Wang Jie retired; he was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent with salary while at home.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Wang Jie retired as Grand Tutor with home salary.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor began the autumn hunt at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔曰：「廣東博羅監犯越獄一案，經朕硃諭查詢，始據該督撫據實陳奏。

translations.literal: On day guisi, an edict said: "In the Boluo prison breakout in Guangdong, only after I made vermilion notes of inquiry did the governor-general and provincial governor at last submit truthful reports according to the facts.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, an edict on the Boluo jailbreak said only the Emperor's vermilion inquiry brought truthful reports.

sentences.zh: 則天下事之不發覺者多矣，殊堪感嘆，更深懍畏。

translations.literal: Then how much more in the empire has gone undetected—deeply moving to sigh and still more deeply making one fear.
translations.idiomatic: How much else nationwide had never come to light—deeply sobering and fear-inspiring.

sentences.zh: 除分別懲治外，尚其大法小廉，用副澂敘官方至意。

translations.literal: Besides separate punishments, let officials both great and small live clean and upright lives to answer the court's intent in clarifying official discipline."
translations.idiomatic: Beyond punishments, all officials were urged to live uprightly and fulfill disciplinary intent.

sentences.zh: 」以興奎為西安將軍，明亮為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: " Xing Kui was made Xi'an general and Mingliang Urumchi military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Kui became Xi'an general and Mingliang, Urumchi governor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，額勒登保奏獲逆首苟文明。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Eledengbao memorialized capture of chief rebel Gou Wenming.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Eledengbao reported chief rebel Gou Wenming captured.

sentences.zh: 諭：「適到木蘭，便聞捷音。

translations.literal: An instruction said: "Just as I arrived at Mulan, good news came.
translations.idiomatic: An order said good news arrived as the Emperor reached Mulan.

sentences.zh: 教匪起事諸犯，只餘此賊。

translations.literal: Of those who rose in the teaching-bandit affair, only this bandit remained.
translations.idiomatic: Only this rebel remained of the White Lotus rising.

sentences.zh: 今既授首，不難肅清。

translations.literal: Now that he has surrendered his head, pacification will not be difficult.
translations.idiomatic: With his capture, full pacification should be easy.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保晉一等伯，楊遇春以下，各優予敘賚。

translations.literal: Eledengbao was advanced to first-class earl; Yang Yuchun and those below were each rewarded by merit according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao became a first-class earl; Yang Yuchun and others were rewarded by rank.

sentences.zh: 」張若渟卒，以熊枚為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: " Zhang Ruoting died; Xiong Mei was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ruoting died and Xiong Mei took punishments.

sentences.zh: 轉汪承霈為左都御史，戴衢亨為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Wang Chengpei was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief and Dai Yuheng made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengpei became left censor-in-chief and Dai Yuheng, minister of war.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day jihai: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jihai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「月朔日食，月望月食，天象示儆，兢惕時深。

translations.literal: An edict said: "When the new moon darkens and the full moon darkens, Heaven shows warning; vigilance is ever deep.
translations.idiomatic: An edict at the eclipse said Heaven warned and vigilance must deepen.

sentences.zh: 朕躬有闕失歟？

translations.literal: Does the Son of Heaven have personal failings?"
translations.idiomatic: Had the Emperor himself failed?

sentences.zh: 剿捕邪匪，餘孽未盡，其應靖以兵威，或迪以德化歟？

translations.literal: In suppressing heterodox bandits, remnants are not yet exhausted—should they be stilled by military might, or led by moral transformation?"
translations.idiomatic: Were rebel remnants to be crushed by arms or won by virtue?

sentences.zh: 政事有不便於民者，或一時行之，日久則滋流弊歟？

translations.literal: Are there matters of government inconvenient to the people that were expedient for a time but over years breed flowing abuses?"
translations.idiomatic: Did temporary policies now burden the people with lasting abuses?

sentences.zh: 其各讜言無隱。

translations.literal: Let each speak frankly without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: All were told to speak frankly without concealment.

sentences.zh: 至月食修刑，惟當於明法敕罰，力求詳慎，所當與內外諸臣交勉焉。

translations.literal: As for repairing punishments at a lunar eclipse, one should only clarify laws and charge punishments, striving for thorough caution—this is what inner and outer officials should jointly urge upon one another."
translations.idiomatic: Eclipse rites meant clarifying law and careful punishment—inner and outer officials should urge one another.

sentences.zh: 」以朱珪協辦大學士。

translations.literal: " Zhu Gui was made Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Gui became Associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以嵇承志為東河河道總督，以劉清為四川按察使。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Ji Chengzhi was made Eastern River waterways governor-general and Liu Qing Sichuan censorial intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Ji Chengzhi took the Eastern River and Liu Qing, Sichuan censor-intendant.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor went out on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 越南農耐、阮福映率屬內附，繳前藩敕印。

translations.literal: Nongnai and Nguyen Phuc Anh of Vietnam led their followers in submission and surrendered former feudal seals and patents.
translations.idiomatic: Vietnam's Nongnai and Nguyen Phuc Anh submitted with followers and returned old seals.

sentences.zh: 詔許其入貢。

translations.literal: An edict permitted them to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: They were permitted to send tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，德楞泰奏獲賊首蒲添寶。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Delengtai memorialized capture of bandit chief Pu Tianbao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Delengtai reported chief Pu Tianbao captured.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengchen: the Emperor returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, gengchen, the Emperor returned from tour.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor went to worship at the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor went to the tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，還京。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙申，吳熊光奏斃黃號匪首唐明萬。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Wu Xiongguang memorialized killing Yellow Faction rebel chief Tang Mingwan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Wu Xiongguang reported Yellow Faction chief Tang Mingwan killed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，杭州將軍弘豐卒，以張承勛為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiyou: Hangzhou General Hong Feng died; Zhang Chengxun was made Hangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, jiyou, Hangzhou General Hong Feng died and Zhang Chengxun replaced him.

sentences.zh: 壬子，勒保奏獲白號賊首張簡、藍號賊首湯思蛟。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Lebao memorialized capture of White Faction bandit chief Zhang Jian and Blue Faction bandit chief Tang Sijiao.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Lebao reported White Faction chief Zhang Jian and Blue Faction chief Tang Sijiao captured.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，德楞泰奏斃賊首戴四，獲賊目趙鑒。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Delengtai memorialized killing bandit chief Dai Si and capturing bandit officer Zhao Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Delengtai reported chief Dai Si killed and officer Zhao Jian captured.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰朔，德楞泰奏獲賊首陳傳學。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day wuchen: Delengtai memorialized capture of bandit chief Chen Chuanxue.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wuchen new moon, Delengtai reported chief Chen Chuanxue captured.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔以吉慶辦理傅羅會匪，奏報不實，免協辦大學士，命那彥成查辦。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, an edict said that Jiqing, in handling the Boluo society bandits, had reported untruthfully; he was dismissed as Associate Grand Secretary and Nayancheng was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Jiqing was dismissed for false Boluo reports and Nayancheng was told to investigate.

sentences.zh: 尋解總督，敕瑚圖理署理。

translations.literal: Soon he was relieved of the governorship; Hutuli was ordered to act.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jiqing lost the governorship and Hutuli acted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，額勒登保奏獲賊首景英，晉三等侯。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Eledengbao memorialized capture of bandit chief Jing Ying; he was advanced to third-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Eledengbao reported Jing Ying captured and became a third-class marquis.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌朔，安徽宿州盜匪作亂，費淳等討平之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day wuxu: bandits rioted in Suzhou, Anhui; Fei Chun and others suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, wuxu new moon, Anhui Suzhou rebels were put down by Fei Chun and others.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔額勒登保、德楞泰、勒保、惠齡、吳熊光會報川、陝、楚教匪蕩平。

translations.literal: On day guichou, an edict ordered Eledengbao, Delengtai, Lebao, Huling, and Wu Xiongguang jointly to report the pacification of teaching bandits in Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, five commanders were ordered to report Sichuan-Shaanxi-Hubei rebels pacified.

sentences.zh: 封額勒登保、德楞泰一等侯，勒保一等伯，明亮一等男，賽沖阿、楊遇春以次封賚。

translations.literal: Eledengbao and Delengtai were enfeoffed first-class earls, Lebao first-class baron, Mingliang first-class baron, and Saichong'a, Yang Yuchun, and others enfeoffed and rewarded in descending order.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao and Delengtai became first-class earls; Lebao, Mingliang, Saichong'a, and Yang Yuchun were enfeoffed by rank.

sentences.zh: 並推恩成親王永瑆等、軍機大臣慶桂、董誥等。

translations.literal: Favor was also extended to Prince Cheng Yongying and others of the imperial clan and Grand Councilors Qing Gui and Dong Gao and others.
translations.idiomatic: Princes including Yongying and councilors Qing Gui and Dong Gao shared the promotion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the joint seasonal sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Emperor performed the joint ancestral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、陝西、江西、四川等省五十六廳州縣災賦。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land tax was remitted for fifty-six subprefectures, prefectures, and counties in Zhili, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Sichuan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, fifty-six disaster districts in four provinces and more lost land tax.

sentences.zh: 除江蘇、福建、山東十縣衛坍田額賦。

translations.literal: Besides this, quota land tax was remitted for collapsed fields in ten counties and guards in Jiangsu, Fujian, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Jiangsu, Fujian, and Shandong districts with collapsed fields lost quota tax.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年癸亥春正月庚午，以倭什布為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Eighth year, guihai year, spring, first month, day gengwu: Wo-shi-bu was made Liang-Guang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 8, gengwu, Wo-shi-bu became Liang-Guang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命伊犁廣開民田。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the people of Ili were ordered to open farmland widely.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Ili was ordered to open civilian farmland widely.

sentences.zh: 張誠基以剿辦義寧州土匪陳奏不實，論絞。

translations.literal: Zhang Chengji, because in suppressing Yining Prefecture native bandits his memorial was untruthful, was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chengji was sentenced to strangulation for false reports on Yining bandits.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜貧民棉衣。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, cotton coats were bestowed on poor people.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, poor people received cotton coats.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiwei, the Emperor went to worship at the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiwei, the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 閏二月戊寅，上還駐圓明園。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day wuyin: the Emperor returned and resided at the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 2, wuyin, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，還宮，入順貞門，奸人陳德突出犯駕。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor returned to the palace; entering Shunzhen Gate, the villain Chen Detu suddenly rushed out and attacked the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, returning to the palace through Shunzhen Gate, Chen Detu suddenly attacked the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 定親王綿恩、額駙拉旺多爾濟及丹巴多爾濟等擒獲之，交廷臣嚴鞫。

translations.literal: Prince Ding Mian'en, imperial son-in-law Lawang Duo'erji, Danba Duo'erji, and others captured him and handed him to court ministers for strict interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Mian'en, Lawang Duo'erji, Danba Duo'erji, and others seized him for strict interrogation by the court.

sentences.zh: 獎賚綿恩等有差。

translations.literal: Mian'en and the others were rewarded by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Mian'en and the others were rewarded in grades.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，祀先農，上親耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the First Farmer was sacrificed to; the Emperor personally plowed the ceremonial field.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor sacrificed to the First Farmer and plowed the ceremonial field in person.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔曰：「陳德之事，視如猘犬，不必窮鞫。

translations.literal: On day jichou, an edict said: "In the matter of Chen De, regard him as a mad dog; there is no need to pursue interrogation to the end.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor said Chen De was like a mad dog and need not be interrogated endlessly.

sentences.zh: 所慚懼者，德化未昭，始有此警予之事耳。

translations.literal: What shames and alarms me is that moral transformation is not yet manifest—only then could there be this warning sent to me.
translations.idiomatic: He said his shame was that virtue was not yet clear enough to prevent this warning to the throne.

sentences.zh: 即按律定擬。

translations.literal: Decide at once according to law."
translations.idiomatic: Let the case be decided by law at once."

sentences.zh: 」是日，陳德及其二子伏誅。

translations.literal: That day Chen De and his two sons were executed.
translations.idiomatic: That day Chen De and his two sons were put to death.

sentences.zh: 予告大學士王傑陛辭，賜玉鳩杖，御書詩章，馳驛回籍。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Secretary Wang Jie took leave at audience; he was granted a jade pigeon staff, an imperial poem, and express relay home.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jie, on retirement leave, received a jade staff, an imperial poem, and express passage home.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，嚴申門禁。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, gate restrictions were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, palace gate security was tightened.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，御試翰林。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: the palace examination of Hanlin academicians was held.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingshen day, the Hanlin palace examination was held.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，甘肅提督穆克登布以剿捕餘匪陣亡，贈二等男。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Gansu Grand Coordinator Mukedengbu died fighting while suppressing remaining bandits; he was posthumously granted Second-rank Baron.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Mukedengbu of Gansu fell fighting bandits and was posthumously made a second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 恤湖北陣亡總兵王懋賞等世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary offices were granted to the families of fallen Hubei commanders including Wang Maoshang.
translations.idiomatic: Families of fallen Hubei commanders including Wang Maoshang received hereditary offices.

sentences.zh: 庚申，皇后行躬桑禮。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Empress performed the mulberry-picking rite in person.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Empress performed the silk-mulberry rite herself.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戌，上祈雨。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingxu: the Emperor prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingxu day, the Emperor prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，雨。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，建宗室、覺羅住房。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yimao: housing was built for imperial clansmen and jueluo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao day, dwellings were built for the imperial clan and jueluo.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以富俊為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Fu Jun was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Fu Jun became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，尚書彭元瑞乞休，允之，仍總裁高宗實錄。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuzi: Minister Peng Yuanrui requested retirement; it was granted, but he still served as chief compiler of the Veritable Records of Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi day, Peng Yuanrui retired but remained chief compiler of Gaozong's Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 以費淳為兵部尚書，陳大文為兩江總督。

translations.literal: Fei Chun was made Minister of War; Chen Dawen, Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Chun took War and Chen Dawen became Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己丑，封阮福映為越南國王。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Ruan Fuying was enfeoffed as king of Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Ruan Fuying was made king of Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，以那彥成為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yisi: Nayancheng was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yisi day, Nayancheng became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以三省餘匪肅清，優敘額勒登保、德楞泰及軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, because remaining bandits in the three provinces had been cleared, Erdeniinbalebao, Delingtai, and the Grand Councilors received exceptional rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, with the three provinces pacified, Erdeniinbalebao, Delingtai, and the Grand Councilors were specially rewarded.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor proceeded to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，調富俊為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renwu: Fu Jun was transferred to be Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renwu day, Fu Jun was moved to Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 以停止行圍迴鑾。

translations.literal: The imperial progress halted because the autumn hunt was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The tour ended when the autumn hunt was suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，致仕尚書、前協辦大學士彭元瑞卒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen: retired Minister and former co-Grand Secretary Peng Yuanrui died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen day, retired minister Peng Yuanrui died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，琅玕奏獲首犯恆乍綱，枲僳匪平。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renshen: Langgan memorialized the capture of chief rebel Hengzhagang; the Xiluo bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on renshen day, Langgan reported Hengzhagang captured and the Xiluo rebels pacified.

sentences.zh: 癸未，葬孝淑皇后於山陵。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Empress Xiaoshu was buried at the mountain tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Empress Xiaoshu was buried at the imperial tomb.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，朱珪等請磨敬一亭明代碑文，上不許。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuxu: Zhu Gui and others asked to grind down the Ming-dynasty stele at the Jingyi Pavilion; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu day, Zhu Gui's request to efface the Jingyi Pavilion Ming stele was refused.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jichou: the seasonal collective offering was performed at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou day, the seasonal temple offering was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山東、河南、江蘇、安徽、陝西、湖北、四川、雲南、甘肅等省四百十八廳州縣衛災賦逋賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster and arrears taxes were remitted by degree in four hundred eighteen subprefectures, counties, and guards of Zhili, Shandong, Henan, Jiangsu, Anhui, Shaanxi, Hubei, Sichuan, Yunnan, Gansu, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster and arrears taxes were forgiven in 418 districts across many provinces by degree.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、越南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Vietnam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Vietnam presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年甲子春正月丁未，調興奎為寧夏將軍，賽沖阿為西安將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day dingwei: Xing Kui was transferred to be Ningxia general; Saichong'a, Xi'an general.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on dingwei day, Xing Kui took Ningxia and Saichong'a Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: the Emperor held the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu day, the Emperor held court lectures on the classics.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上臨幸翰林院，賜宴，賦柏梁體詩。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor visited the Hanlin Academy, granted a feast, and composed verse in the cypress-beam style.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor feasted at the Hanlin Academy and wrote cypress-beam verse.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，幸盤山。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen: the Emperor visited Panshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen day, the Emperor visited Panshan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詣明陵，尊酒長陵。

translations.literal: On day renyin, he visited the Ming tombs and offered wine at Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, he visited the Ming tombs and poured wine at Changling.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jisi: the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Jianrui Camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jisi day, the Emperor reviewed Jianrui Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 丙子，召嵇承志來京，以徐端署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Ji Chengzhi was summoned to the capital; Xu Duan acted as Hedong river-route commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Ji Chengzhi was recalled to Beijing and Xu Duan acted at Hedong river works.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，上祈雨黑龍潭。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，雨。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 丁未，鐵保奏進八旗詩一百三十四卷，賜名熙朝雅頌集。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Tie Bao memorialized presenting one hundred thirty-four volumes of Eight Banners poetry; it was granted the title Elegant Odes of the Flourishing Court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Tie Bao presented 134 volumes of banner poetry, named Elegant Odes of the Flourishing Court.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，玉德等奏海盜蔡牽擾及鹿耳門，突入汕大寨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renxu: Yu De and others memorialized that the pirate Cai Qian was harassing Lukang and had burst into the Shanda stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renxu day, Yu De reported the pirate Cai Qian at Lukang and Shanda stockade.

sentences.zh: 得旨：追擒務獲。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript said: pursue and capture—he must be taken.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript ordered pursuit until Cai Qian was captured.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以祿康協辦大學士，明亮為工部尚書，長麟為刑部尚書，費淳為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Lu Kang was made co-Grand Secretary; Ming Liang, Minister of Works; Chang Lin, Minister of Punishments; Fei Chun, Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Lu Kang joined the Grand Secretariat; Ming Liang took Works; Chang Lin Punishments; Fei Chun Personnel.

sentences.zh: 德瑛罷直軍機處，以那彥成、英和為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: De Ying was removed from the Grand Council; Nayancheng and Yinghe were made Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: De Ying left the Grand Council and Nayancheng and Yinghe joined it.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，惠齡卒，以那彥成為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Hui Ling died; Nayancheng was made Shaan-Gan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Hui Ling died and Nayancheng became Shaan-Gan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 恤捕海盜陣亡總兵胡振聲，贈提督，予世職，錄用其子。

translations.literal: The family of fallen commander Hu Zhensheng, who died fighting pirates, was relieved; he was posthumously made Promotion General, granted a hereditary office, and his son was employed.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zhensheng, killed fighting pirates, was posthumously made Promotion General with a hereditary office for his son.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingwu: the Emperor proceeded to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingwu day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，初彭齡以誣參吳熊光褫職。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Chu Pengling was stripped of office for falsely impeaching Wu Xiongguang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Chu Pengling lost office for a false charge against Wu Xiongguang.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以歲周氵夾甲，停本年決囚。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because the year completed the jia cycle, executions were halted for the year.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, executions were suspended for the year's jia-cycle completion.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，清查湖北濫支軍需，追罰福康安、和琳之子並畢沅等。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiwei: excessive military supplies drawn in Hubei were investigated; the sons of Fukang'an and Hewalin and Bi Yuan and others were fined in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei day, Hubei military overdraws were pursued and Fukang'an's and Hewalin's sons and Bi Yuan were fined.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上迴鑾謁陵。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor returned from progress and visited the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Emperor returned from tour and visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以搜捕三省餘匪淨盡，甄敘額勒登保以次有差。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, because the search for remaining bandits in the three provinces was wholly ended, Erdeniinbalebao and those below received graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, with the three provinces fully pacified, Erdeniinbalebao and others were rewarded by degree.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，廣西武緣知縣孫廷標匿傷縱凶，特旨處絞，臬司公峨遣戍烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiyou: Guangxi Wuyuan magistrate Sun Tingbiao concealed injury and indulged a killer; by special edict he was sentenced to strangulation, and surveillance commissioner Gong'e was exiled to Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guiyou day, Sun Tingbiao was sentenced to strangulation for shielding a killer and Gong'e was exiled to Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上御惇敘殿，賜宴宗室諸王。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor, at Dunxu Hall, granted a feast to the princes of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor feasted the imperial princes at Dunxu Hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，調那彥成為兩廣總督，倭什布為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: Nayancheng was transferred to be Liangguang governor-general; Washibu, Shaan-Gan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wushen day, Nayancheng took Liangguang and Washibu Shaan-Gan.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，調徐端為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingmao: Xu Duan was transferred to be Jiangnan river-route commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingmao day, Xu Duan became Jiangnan river commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大學士劉墉卒。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Grand Secretary Liu Yong died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Grand Secretary Liu Yong died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the seasonal collective offering was performed at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the seasonal temple offering was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、湖北、四川等省二十一廳州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted by degree in twenty-one subprefectures and counties of Zhili, Hubei, Sichuan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster taxes were forgiven in 21 districts of Zhili, Hubei, and Sichuan by degree.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Siam presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年乙丑春正月乙未，予告大學士王傑因賜壽來京卒，優詔恤贈。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, day yimao: retired Grand Secretary Wang Jie, having come to the capital on a birthday grant, died; an excellent burial edict was issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on yimao day, Wang Jie died in Beijing on a birthday visit and received a generous burial edict.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以朱珪為大學士，紀昀協辦大學士，以鐵保為兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Zhu Gui was made Grand Secretary; Ji Yun, co-Grand Secretary; Tie Bao, Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Zhu Gui joined the Grand Secretariat, Ji Yun as co-secretary, and Tie Bao took Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 詔內務府大臣嚴行約束內監，稽其出入，纂入宮史，著為令。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Interior Ministry ministers strictly to restrain eunuchs, audit their comings and goings, compile the rules into palace history, and make them standing regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered strict control of eunuchs, recorded in palace history as permanent rules.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiwei: the Emperor held the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiwei day, the Emperor held court lectures on the classics.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禮親王永恩薨，子昭槤襲。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Prince of Rites Yong'en died; his son Zhaoluoshi inherited.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Prince of Rites Yong'en died and his son Zhaoluoshi succeeded.

sentences.zh: 協辦大學士紀昀卒，調劉權之禮部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Co-Grand Secretary Ji Yun died; Liu Quanzhi was transferred to Minister of Rites and co-Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Yun died and Liu Quanzhi became Minister of Rites and co-Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor visited Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor visited Tailing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，迴鑾，閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, returning from progress, he reviewed the troops of the Jianrui Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, returning from tour, he reviewed Jianrui Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以弘康為廣州將軍。

translations.literal: Hong Kang was made Guangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Kang became Guangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，御史蔡維鈺疏請查禁西洋人刻書傳教。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi: Censor Cai Weiyu memorialized requesting investigation and prohibition of Westerners printing books and preaching religion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinsi day, Cai Weiyu asked to ban Western book-printing and preaching.

sentences.zh: 得旨：一體查禁。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript said: ban it entirely.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript ordered a complete ban.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜彭浚等二百四十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Peng Jun and two hundred forty-three others were granted jinshi and other degrees by difference.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Peng Jun and 243 others received jinshi degrees by rank.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申朔，詔內務府大臣管理西洋堂，未能嚴切稽查，任令傳教，下部議處。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day jiashen: an edict said the Interior Ministry ministers who managed the Western Hall had failed to inspect strictly and had allowed preaching; they were referred to the ministry for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon, jiashen, Western Hall managers were referred for punishment for lax control of preaching.

sentences.zh: 其經卷檢查銷毀，習教之佟瀾等罪之。

translations.literal: The scriptures were inspected and destroyed; Tonglan and others who practiced the teaching were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Missionary scriptures were destroyed and teachers including Tonglan were punished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，追敘削平教匪清野功，加勒保太子太保，明亮一等子。

translations.literal: On day wushen, retrospective rewards were granted for merit in pacifying teaching rebels and clearing the countryside; Jialebao was advanced to Grand Guardian; Ming Liang, first-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, pacification merits raised Jialebao to Grand Guardian and Ming Liang to first-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，顏檢以失察虧帑黜免，調吳熊光為直隸總督，百齡為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengshen: Yan Jian was dismissed and removed for failure to investigate treasury deficits; Wu Xiongguang was made Zhili governor-general; Bai Ling, Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen day, Yan Jian fell over deficits; Wu Xiongguang took Zhili and Bai Ling Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，永定河決。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Yongding River breached.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Yongding River broke its banks.

sentences.zh: 閏六月癸未，劉權之免，以費淳協辦大學士，秦承恩為左都御史。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day guimao: Liu Quanzhi was relieved; Fei Chun was made co-Grand Secretary; Qin Chen'en, Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on guimao day, Liu Quanzhi left office; Fei Chun joined the Grand Secretariat; Qin Chen'en took the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，永定河合龍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Yongding River channels rejoined.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Yongding River was closed again.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以清安泰為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Qing Antai was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Qing Antai became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，上詣盛京謁陵啟鑾。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renchen: the Emperor proceeded to Mukden to visit the tombs and set out the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renchen day, the Emperor set out for Mukden to visit the tombs.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，上祭北鎮廟。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: the Emperor sacrificed at Beizhen Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingxu day, the Emperor sacrificed at Beizhen Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上謁永陵。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor visited Yongling.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor visited Yongling.

sentences.zh: 丙申，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the great feast rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the great feast rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 閱吉林官兵射。

translations.literal: Jilin troops' archery was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor reviewed Jilin troops at archery.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上謁福陵，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor visited Fuling and performed the great feast rite.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor visited Fuling and held the great feast rite.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上謁昭陵，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor visited Zhaoling and performed the great feast rite.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor visited Zhaoling and held the great feast rite.

sentences.zh: 臨奠克勤郡王岳託、武勛王揚古利、弘毅公額亦都、直義公費英東墓。

translations.literal: He personally offered mourning at the tombs of Prince Kegen Yuetuo, Prince of Martial Merit Yangguli, Duke of Hongyi Eidu, and Duke of Direct Loyalty Feiyingdong.
translations.idiomatic: He mourned at the tombs of Yuetuo, Yangguli, Eidu, and Feiyingdong.

sentences.zh: 上駐蹕盛京，詣寶冊前行禮。

translations.literal: The Emperor halted at Mukden and performed rites before the precious registers.
translations.idiomatic: At Mukden the Emperor performed rites before the ancestral registers.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詣天壇、地壇行禮。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, rites were performed at the Altars of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor performed rites at the Heaven and Earth Altars.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上御崇政殿受賀。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor took the throne in the Chongzheng Hall to receive congratulatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor received congratulations in Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 御前大臣、三等公額勒登保卒，建祠京師。

translations.literal: Imperial presence minister and third-rank duke E'le Dengbao died; a shrine was built in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: E'le Dengbao died; a capital shrine was erected.

sentences.zh: 以慶成為成都將軍。

translations.literal: Qingcheng was appointed Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: Qingcheng became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上御大政殿，賜扈從王大臣及朝鮮陪臣宴。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor presided at the Dazheng Hall and granted a feast to accompanying princes and ministers and Korean attending envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, at Dazheng Hall the Emperor feasted the entourage and Korean envoys.

sentences.zh: 御制盛京頌八章。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed eight stanzas of "Ode to Shengjing."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor composed eight stanzas praising Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 賜朝鮮國王李松御書匾額。

translations.literal: An imperial inscribed plaque was bestowed on Korean king Li Song.
translations.idiomatic: Li Song of Korea received an imperial inscribed plaque.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the imperial procession returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor began the return journey.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 壬申，還京。

translations.literal: On day renshen, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，臨奠額勒登保。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, he personally offered mourning for E'le Dengbao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor mourned E'le Dengbao.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，命戴均元馳赴南河勘工。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu: Dai Junyuan was ordered to hurry to the Southern Canal to inspect the works.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on jiawu day, Dai Junyuan was sent to inspect Southern Canal works.

sentences.zh: 丙申，英吉利國王入貢，賜敕並文綺。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the king of England presented tribute; an imperial rescript and patterned silks were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, England sent tribute and received a rescript and silks.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，那彥成免，調吳熊光為兩廣總督，裘行簡署直隸總督。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Nayancheng was dismissed; Wu Xiongguang was transferred to be governor-general of the Two Guang, and Qiu Xingjian was ordered to act as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Nayancheng was dismissed; Wu Xiongguang took the Two Guang and Qiu Xingjian acted at Zhili.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以賽沖阿為廣州將軍。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Saichong'a was appointed Guangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Saichong'a became Guangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，百齡免，以全保為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: Bailing was dismissed; Quanbao was made Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingchen day, Bailing was dismissed and Quanbao took Huguang.

sentences.zh: 己未，以慶溥為湖北提督。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Qingpu was made Hubei provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Qingpu became Hubei provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei: the seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingwei day, the seasonal temple offering was performed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山西、陝西等省三十四州縣災賦及兩淮十一場額課有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes in thirty-four districts of Zhili, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and other provinces were remitted by varying amounts, as were quota levies at eleven Lianghuai salt fields.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster taxes in thirty-four districts and eleven Lianghuai salt quotas were remitted by degree.

sentences.zh: 會計天下民數三萬三千二百一十八萬一千四百三名口，穀數二千九百四十一萬一千九百九十九石七升三合二勺。

translations.literal: The empire's population was reckoned at 332,181,403 persons; stored grain totaled 29,411,999 shi 7 sheng 3 ge 2 shao.
translations.idiomatic: The empire counted 332,181,403 people and 29,411,999 shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、英吉利入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and England presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Korea and England.

sentences.zh: 十一年丙寅春正月壬子，海盜蔡牽陷鳳山縣，命玉德剿辦，調廣州將軍賽沖阿馳往督辦。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, day renzi: pirate Cai Qian took Fengshan county; Yude was ordered to suppress him, and Guangzhou general Saichong'a was transferred to hurry there and supervise.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11, on first-month renzi, Cai Qian took Fengshan; Yude was sent against him and Saichong'a hurried to supervise.

sentences.zh: 丙子，那彥成以在署演戲，濫收海盜，奪職，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Nayancheng was stripped of office for staging plays in his yamen and indiscriminately taking in pirates, and was banished to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Nayancheng was dismissed for theater in office and sheltering pirates and was exiled to Ili.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiwei: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
