translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiwei day, the Emperor lectured on the classics.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 戊申，還京。

translations.literal: On day wushen, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，台灣總兵愛新泰克復鳳山縣，予世職。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: Taiwan brigade commander Aixintai recovered Fengshan county and was granted a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou day, Aixintai recovered Fengshan and received a hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinmao: the Emperor reviewed troops of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on xinmao day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，李亨特免，以吳璥為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Li Hengte was dismissed; Wu Jing was made canal governor of the Eastern He.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Li Hengte was dismissed and Wu Jing took the Eastern He canal command.

sentences.zh: 丙申，續編皇清文穎。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, compilation of the Imperial Qing Literary Collection was continued.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Imperial Qing Literary Collection was continued.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，玉德罷，以阿林保為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingyin: Yude was dismissed; Alinbao was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin day, Yude was dismissed and Alinbao took Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，調姜晟為工部尚書，秦承恩為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuyin: Jiang Sheng was transferred to be Minister of Works and Qin Cheng'en Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuyin day, Jiang Sheng took works and Qin Cheng'en punishments.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，慶成以奏對失實削職，戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Qingcheng was stripped of office for false statements in audience and banished to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Qingcheng was dismissed for false audience statements and exiled to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 以特清額為成都將軍。

translations.literal: Teqing'e was appointed Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: Teqing'e became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以戴均元為江南河道總督，徐端為副總河。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Dai Junyuan was made canal governor of Jiangnan and Xu Duan vice canal director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Dai Junyuan took Jiangnan canals and Xu Duan became vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命德楞泰管理兵部。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Delengtai was ordered to administer the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Delengtai was ordered to run the war ministry.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，寧陝鎮新兵陳逢順糾黨戕官，陷洋縣，擾及寧羌。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guihai: new troops of Ningshan garrison under Chen Fengshun joined factions, killed officials, took Yang county, and disturbed Ningqiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on guihai day, Ningshan new troops under Chen Fengshun killed officials and seized Yang county.

sentences.zh: 命德楞泰統巴圖魯侍衛、索倫兵剿之。

translations.literal: Delengtai was ordered to lead Baturu bodyguards and Solon troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai was sent with Baturu guards and Solon troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor toured Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor toured Mulan.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，上行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengyin: the Emperor conducted the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengyin day, the Emperor hunted in the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李長庚奏剿殲蔡牽匪黨多名，蔡牽逸。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Li Changgeng memorialized that many of Cai Qian's band had been killed or captured; Cai Qian escaped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Li Changgeng reported many of Cai Qian's followers killed; Cai Qian escaped.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，發巴圖魯侍衛、索倫等兵赴陝西。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yisi: Baturu bodyguards, Solon, and other troops were dispatched to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yisi day, Baturu guards and Solon troops were sent to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，論直隸失察侵帑案，顏檢戍烏魯木齊，降姜晟、陳大文、熊枚四品京堂。

translations.literal: On day guichou, in the Zhili case of failure to detect treasury embezzlement, Yan Jian was banished to Urumqi and Jiang Sheng, Chen Dawen, and Xiong Mei were reduced to fourth-rank capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yan Jian was exiled to Urumqi and Jiang Sheng, Chen Dawen, and Xiong Mei were demoted in the Zhili treasury case.

sentences.zh: 起初彭齡為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: At the outset Peng Ling was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Ling was first made Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，起劉權之為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Liu Quanzhi was recalled as Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Liu Quanzhi was recalled as left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上還京。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，德楞泰奏剿平洋縣叛兵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingchou: Delengtai memorialized that the rebel troops at Yang county had been pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on dingchou day, Delengtai reported Yang county rebels pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以全保為陝甘總督，汪志伊為湖廣總督，曹振鏞為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Quanbao was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, Wang Zhiyi Huguang governor-general, and Cao Zhenyong Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Quanbao took Shaanxi-Gansu, Wang Zhiyi Huguang, and Cao Zhenyong works.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以溫承惠為直隸總督。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Wen Chenghui was made Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Wen Chenghui became Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 起阮元署福建巡撫，以病辭。

translations.literal: Ruan Yuan was recalled to act as Fujian governor but declined on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Yuan was recalled to act at Fujian but declined for illness.

sentences.zh: 調張師誠為福建巡撫，金光悌為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhang Shicheng was transferred to be Fujian governor and Jin Guangti Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shicheng took Fujian and Jin Guangti Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以和寧為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Hening was made Urumqi commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Hening became Urumqi commandant.

sentences.zh: 大學士保寧乞休，優詔致仕，予食公俸。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Baoning petitioned to retire; an excellent edict granted honorable retirement with public stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Baoning retired on an excellent edict with public stipend.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，以祿康為大學士，長麟協辦大學士，文寧為步軍統領。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengshen: Lukang was made Grand Secretary, Changlin assisting Grand Secretary, and Wenning Metropolitan Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengshen day, Lukang joined the Grand Secretariat, Changlin assisted, and Wenning took the metropolitan command.

sentences.zh: 詔以德楞泰剿辦叛兵，寬大受降，切責之，降楊遇春寧陝鎮總兵，楊芳遣戍伊犁，即押降兵赴戍。

translations.literal: An edict sharply rebuked Delengtai for too leniently accepting surrenders while suppressing rebels; Yang Yuchun was reduced to Ningshan brigade commander, Yang Fang was banished to Ili, and surrendered troops were immediately escorted to exile.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Delengtai for lenient surrenders, demoted Yang Yuchun, exiled Yang Fang, and sent surrendered troops to Ili.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，大學士朱珪卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuyin: Grand Secretary Zhu Gui died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin day, Zhu Gui died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上臨第賜奠。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor visited his residence to offer mourning gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor mourned at Zhu Gui's residence.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，特詔旗民力求節儉。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, a special edict urged banner people to practice thrift.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, a special edict urged banner thrift.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔曰：「從前剿辦邪匪，鄉勇過多。

sentences.zh: 迨事平遣散為難，多令入伍充兵。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, dispersing them was difficult, and many were enrolled as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: After pacification, dispersing them was hard and many were kept as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 今陝之寧陝，川之綏定，迭報新兵滋事，隨時剿平。

translations.literal: Now at Ningshan in Shaanxi and Suining in Sichuan reports of new troops causing trouble follow one another; they are promptly suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: Now Ningshan and Suining report new troops in repeated trouble, promptly suppressed.

sentences.zh: 此等獷悍之徒，必須隨時懲創，勿令別生事端。

translations.literal: Such violent men must be punished whenever needed, lest they spawn new trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Such violent men must be punished at once so they do not stir new trouble.

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，陝西瓦石坪新兵滋事，討平之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, new troops at Washiping in Shaanxi rebelled and were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Washiping new troops in Shaanxi rebelled and were pacified.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，上御經筵，戊子，積拉堪罷，削爵。

translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu day, the Emperor lectured on the classics; on wuzi day Jilakan was dismissed and stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上謁東陵。

translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Gaozong's Veritable Records and Sacred Instructions were completed.

translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor prayed for rain.

translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, rain fell.

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on bingxu day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor prayed for rain.

translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, river-work material prices were raised.

translations.idiomatic: Since Yongzheng the annual works budget had been 600,000 taels; it now rose to 1,600,000.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，禁督撫幕友矇保入官。

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiwei day, governors were forbidden to let secretaries buy office through influence.

translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor began the return journey.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on yiwei day, military exams dropped policy essays and required silent transcription of military classics.

sentences.zh: 得旨照準，賞老民銀緞。

translations.literal: The edict approved; the old man was rewarded with silver and silk.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved and the informant rewarded with silver and satin.

translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Qufu Confucian temple was ordered repaired.

translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor prayed for snow.

translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, it snowed.

translations.literal: Zhou Xingdai was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Xingdai became left censor-in-chief.

translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the imperial ancestral temple held the joint seasonal rite.

translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Bailing became Liang-Guang governor-general.

translations.literal: Jin Chang was made Yili general; Xingzhao was made Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Chang took Yili and Xingzhao took Jingzhou as generals.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，賜洪瑩等二百四十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day jiayin: Hong Ying and two hundred forty-one others received jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month on jiayin day, Hong Ying and 241 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 吳熊光戍伊犁，百齡劾之也。

translations.literal: Wu Xiongguang was exiled to Yili at Bailing's impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: Bailing's impeachment sent Wu Xiongguang to Yili.

sentences.zh: 孫玉庭罷。

translations.literal: Sun Yuting was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yuting left office.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，特詔切責廷臣泄沓。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingchou: a special edict sharply rebuked court officials for slackness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on dingchou day, a special edict rebuked lax officials.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，巡漕御史英綸以貪婪卑污處絞。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, grain-transport censor Ying Lun was sentenced to strangulation for greed and base conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, censor Ying Lun was strangled for corruption and vileness.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，倉場黑檔盜米事發，責黜歷任侍郎有差。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiwei: a granary black-ledger rice theft case broke; former vice ministers were blamed and demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on yiwei day, a granary fraud scandal brought graded demotions of former vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以松筠為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Songyun was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Songyun became Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，詔停本年秋決。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen: autumn executions were suspended for the year.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month on wuchen day, autumn executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 江蘇查賑知縣李毓昌為山陽知縣王伸漢毒斃，下部鞫實，王伸漢立斬，知府王轂立絞，家丁李祥等均極刑，總督鐵保奪職遣戍，巡撫汪日章奪職。

translations.literal: In Jiangsu, relief magistrate Li Yuchang was poisoned to death by Shanyang magistrate Wang Shenhan; after investigation Wang Shenhan was immediately beheaded, prefect Wang Gu was immediately strangled, steward Li Xiang and others received extreme penalties, governor-general Tiebao was stripped and exiled, and governor Wang Rizhang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Li Yuchang was murdered by Wang Shenhan; Wang was beheaded, Wang Gu was strangled, servants were executed, Tiebao was exiled, and Wang Rizhang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 上制憫忠詩，賜其嗣子李希佐舉人、控訴得申武生李清泰武舉。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed a "Lament for the Loyal" poem, granted Li Yuchang's son Li Xizuo the juren degree, and made petitioner Li Qingtai a military juren and then military juren-examinee.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial lament poem went to Li Xizuo as juren and Li Qingtai as military juren and then military juren-examinee.

sentences.zh: 調阿林保為兩江總督，以方維甸為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Alinbao was transferred to be Liangjiang governor-general; Fang Weidian was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Alinbao took Liangjiang and Fang Weidian took Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，給事中花傑以參劾軍機大臣戴衢亨徇私不得直降官。

translations.literal: On day renshen, supervising secretary Hua Jie was demoted for impeaching Grand Councilor Dai Quheng for favoritism without substantiation.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Hua Jie was demoted for an unsubstantiated charge against Dai Quheng.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔曰：「朕恫瘝在抱，每直省報災，無不立霈恩施，多方賑恤。

translations.literal: On day yihai, an edict said: "I hold the people in compassionate care; whenever a province reports disaster, relief is immediately sent with every means of aid.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, an edict said the throne responds at once to every provincial disaster report.

sentences.zh: 乃督撫不加查察，致有冒賑之事。

translations.literal: Yet governors-general and governors fail to investigate, so fraudulent relief occurs.
translations.idiomatic: Yet governors fail to check, and relief fraud follows.

sentences.zh: 如近日寶坻、山陽二案，竟謀斃持正委員，豈可不加以懲治，非有所靳惜也。

translations.literal: Cases such as Baodi and Shanyang recently even plotted to kill upright relief commissioners—how can this go unpunished? It is not that I am reluctant to punish.
translations.idiomatic: Baodi and Shanyang even killed upright commissioners, and punishment cannot be withheld.

sentences.zh: 御史周鉞因請報災之處，另委道府詳查。

translations.literal: Censor Zhou Yin therefore asked that disaster reports be separately assigned to circuit and prefectural officials for detailed inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhou Yin wanted separate circuit and prefect inspections of disaster reports.

sentences.zh: 不知道府又安盡賢能。

translations.literal: How can one know that circuit and prefectural officials are all capable?
translations.idiomatic: But not every circuit or prefect official is capable.

sentences.zh: 現在寶坻一案，該管東路同知歸恩燕即曾索銀三千兩。

translations.literal: In the present Baodi case, the responsible Eastern Route sub-prefect Gui Enyan once demanded three thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In Baodi, sub-prefect Gui Enyan had demanded 3,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 山陽一案，該管知府王轂收銀二千兩。

translations.literal: In the Shanyang case, the responsible prefect Wang Gu took two thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In Shanyang, prefect Wang Gu took 2,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 設遇此類道府，又可信乎！

translations.literal: If one meets circuit and prefectural officials of this kind, can they be trusted!
translations.idiomatic: Such circuit and prefect officials cannot be trusted.

sentences.zh: 道府亦不能遍歷村莊，仍委之委員，益不足憑矣。

translations.literal: Circuit and prefectural officials cannot visit every village themselves and still delegate to commissioners, which is even less reliable.
translations.idiomatic: They cannot visit every village and still rely on commissioners.

sentences.zh: 其要惟在督撫得人耳。

translations.literal: The essential point is only to have capable governors-general and governors.
translations.idiomatic: The key is appointing capable governors.

sentences.zh: 至若以查災為難，因而相率諱災，則其咎更重矣。

translations.literal: As for treating disaster inspection as difficult and therefore collectively concealing disasters, the guilt is still heavier.
translations.idiomatic: Concealing disasters to avoid inspection is an even graver fault.

sentences.zh: 將此通諭知之。

translations.literal: Let this be communicated for general knowledge."
translations.idiomatic: The edict ordered the message circulated.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: "" On day renwu, the Emperor toured Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed." On renwu day, the Emperor visited Mulan.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，浙江學政、侍郎劉鳳誥以監臨舞弊褫職，戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu: Zhejiang education intendant and vice minister Liu Fenggao was dismissed for examination malpractice and exiled to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengxu day, Liu Fenggao was dismissed for exam fraud and sent to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 巡撫阮元以徇隱奪職。

translations.literal: Governor Ruan Yuan was dismissed for concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ruan Yuan lost office for covering up the case.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以慶成為福州將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiwei: Qingcheng was made Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiwei day, Qingcheng became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，張師誠疏報王得祿、邱良功合剿海盜蔡牽，緊逼賊船，沖斷船尾，蔡牽落海淹斃。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Zhang Shicheng memorialized that Wang Delu and Qiu Lianggong jointly attacked pirate Cai Qian, pressed the rebel ship hard, broke off its stern, and Cai Qian fell into the sea and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Zhang Shicheng reported Wang Delu and Qiu Lianggong cornered pirate Cai Qian, broke his ship, and drowned him.

sentences.zh: 予王得祿子爵，邱良功男爵。

translations.literal: Wang Delu was granted a viscountcy and Qiu Lianggong a baronetcy.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Delu received a viscountcy and Qiu Lianggong a baronetcy.

sentences.zh: 壬申，百齡疏請粵鹽改陸運，從之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Bailing memorialized asking that Guangdong salt be transported overland; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Bailing's request to move Guangdong salt by land was approved.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，上萬壽節，御太和殿受賀，賜宴。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day guisi: the Longevity Festival; the Emperor received congratulations in the Hall of Supreme Harmony and gave a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter tenth month's guisi day, the Longevity Festival brought court congratulations and a banquet.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，阿林保疏請漕糧加折收納，上嚴斥之。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Alinbao memorialized asking that grain transport accept extra fold collection; the Emperor sternly rebuked it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Alinbao's proposal for extra grain-transport surcharges was sharply rejected.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，以松筠為兩江總督，那彥成為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renchen: Songyun was made Liangjiang governor-general; Nayancheng was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renchen day, Songyun took Liangjiang and Nayancheng took Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，以失察工部書吏冒領戶部、內務府官銀，祿康、費淳以次降黜。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuxu: because Board of Works clerks had fraudulently drawn Ministry of Revenue and Imperial Household Department official silver without detection, Lu Kang, Fei Chun, and others were demoted in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Lu Kang, Fei Chun, and others were demoted for undetected Works-clerk fraud on Revenue and Household funds.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the imperial ancestral temple held the joint seasonal rite.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江蘇等省二十四州縣災賦。

translations.literal: This year, disaster taxes were remitted for twenty-four prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangsu, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: This year, disaster taxes were forgiven in twenty-four districts of Zhili, Jiangsu, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 除順天文安窪地、浙江錢清場、湖南茶州坍地田賦。

translations.literal: Land tax was remitted for low-lying fields in Wen'an, Shuntian, collapsed salt plots at Qianqing, Zhejiang, and collapsed land at Chazhou, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Wen'an lowlands, Zhejiang's Qianqing salt field, and Hunan's Chazhou lost land tax after collapse.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、越南、南掌入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, Vietnam, and Lan Xang sent tribute missions.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute arrived from Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, Vietnam, and Lan Xang.

sentences.zh: 十五年庚午春正月丙子，以劉權之為協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, spring first month, day bingzi: Liu Quanzhi was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 on spring bingzi day, Liu Quanzhi became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jichou: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jichou day, the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，長麟以疾免，以瑚圖禮為刑部尚書，托津為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Chang Lin was dismissed owing to illness; Hutuli was made Minister of Punishments and Tuojin Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Chang Lin left for illness; Hutuli took punishments and Tuojin took works.

sentences.zh: 丙申，召勒保來京，以常明為四川總督。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Lebao was summoned to the capital; Chang Ming was made Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Lebao was called to Beijing and Chang Ming took Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔以鴉片煙戕生，通飭督撫斷其來源。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, an edict ordered governors-general and governors everywhere to cut off the source of opium because it harms life.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, an edict ordered all governors to stop opium at its source.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiazi day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the encirclement hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 癸未，還京。

translations.literal: On day guimao, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day dingyou: the Emperor reviewed troops of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month on dingyou day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，勒保以不奏匿名書，罷大學士，降工部尚書。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai: Lebao was dismissed as grand secretary and demoted to Minister of Works for failing to memorialize an anonymous letter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on guihai day, Lebao lost the grand secretary post and became works minister for suppressing an anonymous letter.

sentences.zh: 復以祿康為大學士，明亮協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Lu Kang was again made grand secretary and Mingliang associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kang again became grand secretary and Mingliang associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 以戴衢亨為大學士，費淳為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Dai Yuheng was made Grand Secretary and Fei Chun Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Yuheng became Grand Secretary and Fei Chun Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，改熱河副都統為都統，以積拉堪補授。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuxu: the Rehe vice commander-in-chief post was changed to commander-in-chief, and Jilakan was appointed to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuxu day, Rehe's vice commander became commander-in-chief and Jilakan was appointed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，百齡以擒解海盜烏石二功，予輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Bailing was granted the hereditary title Light Chariot Commandant for merit in capturing and delivering the pirate Wu Shier.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Bailing received a hereditary commandant title for capturing the pirate Wu Shier.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，永定河溢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiayin: the Yongding River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiayin day, the Yongding River burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor toured to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以徐端為南河河道總督。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Xu Duan was made Southern River waterways governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Xu Duan became Southern River waterways governor-general.

sentences.zh: 修改雲梯關海口，命馬慧裕督辦。

translations.literal: The Yuntiguan estuary was repaired, with Ma Huiyu ordered to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Yuntiguan estuary repairs were ordered under Ma Huiyu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，上行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuxu: the Emperor went on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuxu day, the Emperor began the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以皂保為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Zhaobao was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Zhaobao became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 設廣東水師提督，陽江鎮水師總兵。

translations.literal: A Guangdong naval commander-in-chief was established, and a Yangjiang naval brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong gained a naval commander-in-chief and Yangjiang a naval brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以汪志伊為閩浙總督，馬慧裕為湖廣總督，恭阿拉為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiwei: Wang Zhiyi was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, Ma Huiyu Huguang governor-general, and Gongala Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Wang Zhiyi took Fujian-Zhejiang, Ma Huiyu Huguang, and Gongala the works ministry.

sentences.zh: 甲子，永定河漫口合龍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Yongding River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Yongding breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，增南河稭料價銀。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the price of straw materials for the Southern River was increased in silver.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Southern River straw-material payments were raised.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，江南高堰、山盱兩堤決壩。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu: the Gaoyan and Shanxu dikes in Jiangnan burst.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Gaoyan and Shanxu dikes in Jiangnan failed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，定部院直日例。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, regulations for daily duty rotation in ministries and courts were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, ministry and court daily-duty rules were set.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，前吉林將軍秀林以盜用葠銀，賜死。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renxu: former Jilin general Xiulin was granted death for embezzling ginseng funds.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, ex-general Xiulin was sentenced to death for ginseng embezzlement.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，廣西疏報壽民藍祥一百四十二歲，特賜御制詩章、御書匾額、六品頂戴、銀五十兩。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingshen: Guangxi reported the long-lived subject Lan Xiang at one hundred forty-two years of age; he was specially granted an imperial poem, an imperial inscribed plaque, a sixth-rank hat button, and fifty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Lan Xiang, aged 142, received an imperial poem, plaque, rank insignia, and silver.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，馬慧裕奏雲梯關大工合龍，河歸正道入海。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Ma Huiyu memorialized that the great Yuntiguan works were closed and the river returned to its proper course to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Ma Huiyu reported Yuntiguan works complete and the river restored.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: An edict commended him.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised him.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以陳鳳翔為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Chen Fengxiang was made Jiangnan waterways governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Chen Fengxiang became Jiangnan waterways governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，調興肇察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Xingzhao was transferred as Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Xingzhao was moved to Chahar command.

sentences.zh: 己酉，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, joint seasonal sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the seasonal temple joint sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸七州縣災賦。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land tax was remitted for seven Zhili prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That year seven Zhili districts were forgiven disaster taxes.

sentences.zh: 除江蘇丹徒、上海坍田，安徽無為州廢田田賦。

translations.literal: Land tax on collapsed fields in Dantu and Shanghai, Jiangsu, and on abandoned fields in Wuwei Prefecture, Anhui, was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Collapsed Jiangsu fields and abandoned Anhui fields were exempted from tax.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Siam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十六年辛未春正月戊午，以雲梯關馬港新築長堤，增設淮海道，海安、海阜二廳同知。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, xinwei, spring, first month, day wuwu: because a new long dike was built at Yuntiguan Horse Harbor, the Huaihai circuit was added, with assistant prefects at Hai'an and Haifu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 16 spring, Huaihai circuit and two subprefects were added for the new Yuntiguan dike.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以百齡為刑部尚書，松筠調兩廣總督，勒保為兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Bailing was made Minister of Punishments, Songyun transferred to Guangdong governor-general, and Lebao to Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Bailing took punishments, Songyun Guangdong, and Lebao Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day renwu: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu day, the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，釋奠先師孔子。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, sacrifice was offered to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Confucius received sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕因連年南河河工糜費至四千餘萬，特命托津、初彭齡前往查察。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Because Southern River works over successive years have consumed more than forty million taels, I specially ordered Tuojin and Chu Pengling to go and investigate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted forty million taels spent on Southern River works and ordered Tuojin and Chu Pengling to investigate.

sentences.zh: 茲據奏覆，查勘工帳銀款出入尚屬相符，而工程未盡堅固。

translations.literal: According to their report on examination, audited funds received and disbursed still correspond, but the works are not yet entirely solid.
translations.idiomatic: Their audit found funds balanced but works still unsound.

sentences.zh: 此實歷任河臣之咎，吳璥、徐端俱降革有差。

translations.literal: This is truly the blame of successive river officials; Wu Jun and Xu Duan were each demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Past river officials were blamed; Wu Jun and Xu Duan were demoted.

sentences.zh: 在工人員一併斥革。

translations.literal: Work staff are to be dismissed together.
translations.idiomatic: On-site staff were all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 其未發銀六十萬，並著停發。

translations.literal: The six hundred thousand taels not yet issued are likewise ordered withheld.
translations.idiomatic: Six hundred thousand taels still unissued were withheld.
The edict ended.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingyin: the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，謁陵禮成，西巡五台山。

translations.literal: On day renwu, after the tomb rites were completed, he toured west to Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, tomb rites done, he went west to Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，工部尚書費淳卒，贈大學士。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Minister of Works Fei Chun died and was posthumously granted Grand Secretary rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Fei Chun died and was posthumously made Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 以肅親王永錫為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Prince Su Yongxi was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Su Yongxi became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 閏三月庚辰，上駐蹕五台山。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day gengchen: the Emperor halted at Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, on gengchen day, he stayed at Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor returned in imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the imperial progress returned.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上謁堯母陵、帝堯廟行禮。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor visited Empress Yao's tomb and the Emperor Yao Temple and performed rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, he worshipped at Empress Yao's tomb and the Yao Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上閱直隸綠營兵，幸蓮池書院，遣官祭明臣楊繼盛祠。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor reviewed Zhili Green Standard troops, visited Lianchi Academy, and dispatched an official to sacrifice at the shrine of Ming minister Yang Jisheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, he reviewed Zhili troops, visited Lianchi Academy, and sacrificed at Yang Jisheng's shrine.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，大學士戴衢亨卒。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen: Grand Secretary Dai Yuheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wushen day, Dai Yuheng died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 致仕協辦大學士長麟卒。

translations.literal: Retired cooperating Grand Secretary Chang Lin died.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Assistant Grand Secretary Chang Lin died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜蔣立鏞等二百三十七人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Jiang Lilong and two hundred thirty-seven others received jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Jiang Lilong and 237 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 以福慶為漢軍都統，崇祿為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Fu Qing was made Hanjun commander-in-chief and Chongluo Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Qing became Hanjun commander-in-chief and Chongluo Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，以劉權之為大學士，鄒炳泰協辦大學士，劉鐶之兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: Liu Quanzhi was made Grand Secretary, Zou Bingtai cooperating Grand Secretary, and Liu Huan Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Liu Quanzhi became Grand Secretary, Zou Bingtai assistant, and Liu Huan war minister.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上再詣天神壇祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor again went to the Heavenly Spirits Altar to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor again prayed for rain at the Heavenly Spirits Altar.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，雨。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，明亮以覆奏不實，降副都統。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renwu: Mingliang was demoted to vice commander-in-chief for an untrue memorial reply.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Mingliang was demoted for a false memorial reply.

sentences.zh: 以松筠為協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Songyun was made cooperating Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun became cooperating Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，祿康以覆奏不實，降副都統。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Lukang was demoted to vice commander-in-chief for an untrue memorial reply.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Lukang was demoted for a false reply.

sentences.zh: 以勒保為大學士，管理吏部，吉綸為工部尚書、步軍統領。

translations.literal: Lebao was made Grand Secretary directing the Board of Civil Office; Ji Lun was Minister of Works and metropolitan gendarmerie commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao became Grand Secretary over civil appointments; Ji Lun took works and the gendarmerie.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，湖南按察使傅鼐卒，贈巡撫，許建專祠。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Hunan surveillance commissioner Fu Nai died and was posthumously granted governor rank; a private shrine was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Fu Nai died, was posthumously made governor, and granted a shrine.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，命光祿寺少卿盧蔭溥入直軍機處，加四品卿銜。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuyin: Court of Imperial Entertainments vice director Lu Yinpu was ordered into the Grand Council and given fourth-rank minister counselor rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Lu Yinpu entered the Grand Council with fourth-rank counselor rank.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禁西洋人潛居內地。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Westerners secretly residing inland were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, secret inland residence by Westerners was banned.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor toured to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，江南李家樓河決。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Li Family Tower River in Jiangnan burst.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Jiangnan's Li Family Tower River broke.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，興肇以老免，起貢楚克紥布為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Xingzhao was excused for age; Guntukezhabu was recalled as Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Xingzhao retired and Guntukezhabu became Chahar commander.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，上行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renxu: the Emperor went on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renxu day, the Emperor began the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，建興安大嶺神祠，春秋致祀，戊子，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jimao: a shrine to the god of the Great Ridge of Xing'an was built, with spring and autumn sacrifices; on day wuzi, the Emperor returned in imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, an Xing'an ridge shrine was founded; on wuzi day the imperial progress returned.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以松筠為吏部尚書，蔣攸銛為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Songyun was made Minister of Civil Office and Jiang Youxian Guangdong governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Songyun took civil office and Jiang Youxian Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor visited the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上還京。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，四川十二支嶺夷向化，改土歸流。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, twelve Yi branches in Sichuan submitted and were converted from native chieftain rule to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, twelve Sichuan Yi branches were converted to regular rule.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，敕改運河邳、宿工程復歸河員管理。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengzi: an edict ordered the Pi and Su canal works on the Grand Canal restored to river officials' management.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Pi-Su canal works were returned to river officials.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，以和寧為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: Hening was made Shengjing general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guichou day, Hening became Shengjing general.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, joint seasonal sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the seasonal temple joint sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免順天、江蘇、河南等省八州縣災賦。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land tax was remitted for eight prefectures and counties in Shuntian, Jiangsu, Henan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year eight disaster districts in Shuntian, Jiangsu, Henan, and elsewhere were relieved.

sentences.zh: 除甘肅逋賦，又除喀什噶爾回莊田賦。

translations.literal: Arrears in Gansu were remitted, and land tax on Kashgar Muslim village fields was also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu arrears were forgiven and Kashgar village land tax abolished.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、緬甸入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Burma presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Burma sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年壬申春正月壬午，時享太廟，命皇次子行禮。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, renshen, spring, first month, day renwu: seasonal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the second imperial son performed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 17 spring, the second imperial son led the temple seasonal sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰朔，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day jiachen: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the second-month new moon, on jiachen day, the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi: the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以明亮為西安將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Mingliang was made Xi'an general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Mingliang became Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上御晾鷹台，大閱八旗官兵。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor went to Liangying Terrace and held a grand review of the Eight Banners officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor reviewed the Eight Banners at Liangying Terrace.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，詔曰：「八旗生齒日繁，亟宜廣籌生計。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen: an edict said: "The Eight Banners population grows daily; livelihoods must urgently be broadened.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, an edict urged broader livelihoods as banner population grew.

sentences.zh: 朕聞吉林土膏沃衍，地廣人稀。

translations.literal: I hear that Jilin soil is rich and fertile, with broad lands and sparse people.
translations.idiomatic: It noted Jilin's fertile, sparsely settled lands.

sentences.zh: 柳條邊外，葠場移遠，其間空曠之地，不下千有餘里，多屬腴壤，流民時有前往耕植。

translations.literal: Beyond the Willow Palisade, ginseng grounds have shifted far outward; the open land between stretches more than a thousand li, mostly fertile soil, and migrants sometimes go to farm it.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the palisade lay over a thousand li of fertile open land migrants sometimes farmed.

sentences.zh: 應援乾隆年間拉林成案，將閒散旗丁送往吉林，撥給地畝，或耕或佃，以資養贍。

translations.literal: Following the Qianlong-era Lalin precedent, idle bannermen should be sent to Jilin with land allotted to farm or rent for support.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Lalin precedent, idle bannermen should be sent to Jilin with land to farm or rent.

sentences.zh: 農暇仍可練習騎射，以備當差，教養兩得其益。

translations.literal: In farming intervals they may still practice mounted archery to prepare for service, benefiting both nurture and training.
translations.idiomatic: They could still drill archery in slack seasons while gaining a livelihood.

sentences.zh: 該將軍等盡心籌畫，區分棲止，詳度以聞。

translations.literal: The generals there are to plan carefully, assign dwelling districts, and report details.
translations.idiomatic: Generals were told to plan settlements and report.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: " On day bingchen, the Emperor reviewed the Jianrui Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended." On bingchen day, the Emperor reviewed the Jianrui Camp.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，護軍統領紥克塔爾卒，予銀三百兩。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Guards commander Zhaktar died and was granted three hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Zhaktar died and received 300 taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，溫承惠奏灤州拏獲金丹、八卦邪教董懷信等。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuzi: Wen Chenghui memorialized capture at Luanzhou of Jindan and Bagua sect leader Dong Huaixin and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Wen Chenghui reported capturing Dong Huaixin and other sect leaders at Luanzhou.

sentences.zh: 得旨：從嚴懲辦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，移閒散宗室於盛京居住，築室給田給銀。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yisi: idle imperial clansmen were moved to reside in Shengjing; houses were built and fields and silver granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, idle clansmen were settled in Shengjing with housing, land, and silver.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuzi: the Emperor toured to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuzi day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，陳鳳翔以不職免，以黎世序為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renzi: Chen Fengxiang was removed for misconduct; Li Shixu was made Jiangnan waterways governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Chen Fengxiang was dismissed and Li Shixu made Jiangnan waterways governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以阮元為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Ruan Yuan was made grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Ruan Yuan became grain transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Emperor began the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，上還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲午，慶桂以年老罷，以松筠為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Qing Gui retired for age; Songyun was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Qing Gui retired and Songyun joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，以恭阿拉為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingmao: Gongala was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingmao day, Gongala became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，以景安為理藩院尚書兼漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinwei: Jing'an was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs while also serving as Banner general of the Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei day, Jing'an became Colonial Affairs minister and Han Army banner general.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，以鐵保為禮部尚書，潘世恩為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renzi: Tiebao was made Minister of Rites; Pan Shien Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renzi day, Tiebao took Rites and Pan Shien took Works.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以興肇為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Xingzhao was made Jiangning general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Xingzhao became Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免順天、奉天、直隸、河南、安徽等省二十七州縣災賦、逋賦、旗租，台灣噶瑪蘭水沖田賦。

translations.literal: That year, disaster tax, arrears tax, and banner rent were remitted in twenty-seven prefectures and counties of Zhili, Fengtian, Henan, Anhui, and other provinces; Taiwan Gamelan flood-damaged field tax was also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster and arrears taxes were forgiven in twenty-seven counties of Zhili, Fengtian, Henan, and Anhui, and Gamelan flood fields in Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十八年癸酉春正月乙亥，軍機大臣松筠罷為御前大臣，以勒保為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, spring, first month, day yihai: Grand Councilor Songyun was removed to serve as Grand Minister in attendance; Lebao was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 18, on first-month yihai, Songyun left the Grand Council for attendance duty and Lebao joined it.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi: the Emperor held the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengzi day, the Emperor lectured on the Classics.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingchou day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，以明亮為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jihai: Mingliang was made Mongol banner general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jihai day, Mingliang became Mongol banner general.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以富俊為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Fujun was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Fujun became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，上祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengchen: the Emperor prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen day, the Emperor prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，雨。

translations.literal: On day renchen, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, it rained.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，賜進書生員鮑廷博舉人。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: licentiate book donor Bao Tingbo was granted juren status.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao day, Bao Tingbo received juren for donating books.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以松筠為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Songyun was made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Songyun became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，申嚴販運鴉片煙律，食者並罪之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiaxu: laws against trafficking opium were strictly enforced, and consumers were also punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiaxu day, opium trafficking was banned and users punished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，御史馮大中疏言中外臣工辦事遲延怠緩，請旨稽覈，上是之。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Censor Feng Dazhong memorialized that civil and military officials at court and in the provinces were dilatory and slack in business, and asked that they be audited by imperial order; the Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Feng Dazhong urged auditing slack officials and the Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor went on progress to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，上行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu: the Emperor conducted the hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu day, the Emperor hunted.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，上以陰雨減圍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi: because of continuous rain, the encampment hunt was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, rain shortened the Mulan hunt.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor returned from progress.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Emperor returned from Mulan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，河南睢州河溢。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the river overflowed at Suizhou in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Suizhou river burst its banks in Henan.

sentences.zh: 河南滑縣八卦教匪李文成糾眾謀逆，知縣強克捷捕繫獄。

translations.literal: In Huaxian, Henan, Eight Trigrams sect bandit Li Wencheng gathered followers to plot rebellion; Magistrate Qiang Kejie arrested and imprisoned them.
translations.idiomatic: At Huaxian, Li Wencheng's Eight Trigrams plot was uncovered and Magistrate Qiang Kejie jailed the ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 其黨馮克善、牛亮臣陷縣城，克捷死之。

translations.literal: His partisans Feng Keshan and Niu Liangchen seized the county seat and Kejie died.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Keshan and Niu Liangchen took the city and killed Kejie.

sentences.zh: 直隸長垣、山東曹縣賊黨咸應。

translations.literal: Bandit factions in Changyuan, Zhili, and Caoxian, Shandong, all rose in response.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels in Changyuan, Zhili, and Caoxian, Shandong, joined the uprising.

sentences.zh: 上命高杞、同興防堵，溫承惠佩欽差大臣關防剿之。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Gao Qi and Tongxing to block them, and Wen Chenghui, wearing the seal of Imperial Commissioner, to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qi and Tongxing were sent to hold the rebels while Wen Chenghui was commissioned to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 召楊遇春統兵北上。

translations.literal: Yang Yuchun was summoned to command troops north.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuchun was called north with an army.

sentences.zh: 賊黨徐安幗陷長垣，戕知縣趙綸。

translations.literal: Bandit partisan Xu Angui seized Changyuan and killed Magistrate Zhao Lun.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Angui took Changyuan and killed Magistrate Zhao Lun.

sentences.zh: 金鄉知縣吳階捕賊崔士俊等。

translations.literal: Jinxiang Magistrate Wu Jie arrested the bandits Cui Shijun and others.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jie of Jinxiang captured Cui Shijun and other rebels.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上行次棽髻山。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor halted at Mount Senji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor stopped at Mount Senji.

sentences.zh: 是日，奸人陳爽數十人突入紫禁城，將逼內宮，皇次子用槍殪其一人。

translations.literal: That day, several dozen villains led by Chen Shuang suddenly entered the Forbidden City and were about to force the inner palace; the second imperial son shot one dead with a musket.
translations.idiomatic: That day, Chen Shuang and dozens stormed the Forbidden City; the second imperial son shot one dead.

sentences.zh: 一賊登月華門牆，執旗指揮，皇次子再用槍擊之墜，貝勒綿志續殪其一。

translations.literal: One bandit climbed the wall of the Moon Splendor Gate and waved a banner to direct them; the second imperial son shot him down with another shot, and Prince Mianzhi killed another.
translations.idiomatic: A rebel on the Moon Splendor Gate wall was shot down by the second son; Prince Mianzhi killed another.

sentences.zh: 王大臣率健銳、火器營兵入，盡捕斬之。

translations.literal: Wang Dachen led Brave and Sharp and Firearms camp troops inside and captured and executed them all.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dachen's troops entered and killed or captured all the intruders.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔封皇次子為智親王，綿志郡王銜。

translations.literal: On day jimao, an edict enfeoffed the second imperial son as Prince Zhi and granted Mianzhi the rank of prince of the second degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the second son became Prince Zhi and Mianzhi received a prince's rank.

sentences.zh: 論捕賊功，各予獎敘。

translations.literal: Merit in capturing the bandits was discussed and rewards were granted by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Capture merits were graded and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 奪吉綸職，以英和為步軍統領。

translations.literal: Ji Lun was stripped of office; Yinghe was made metropolitan commandant of the Gendarmerie.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Lun was dismissed and Yinghe became metropolitan gendarmerie commandant.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔曰：「朕紹承大統，不敢暇逸，不敢為虐民之事。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, an edict said: "We have received the great succession and dare not be idle, nor dare do things that oppress the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, an edict declared: "Having received the throne, We dare not be idle or oppress the people.

sentences.zh: 自川、楚教匪平後，方期與吾民共享承平之福，乃昨九月十五日，大內突有非常之事。

translations.literal: After the Sichuan-Huguang sect bandits were pacified, We looked to share lasting peace with Our people; yet on the fifteenth of last ninth month there was this extraordinary event within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: After the Sichuan-Huguang rebels were crushed, We hoped for peace; yet on the fifteenth of last ninth month the palace was struck by an unheard-of assault.

sentences.zh: 漢、唐、宋、明之所未有，朕實恧焉。

translations.literal: What Han, Tang, Song, and Ming never knew—We are truly ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing like it had occurred since Han, Tang, Song, and Ming, and We are ashamed.

sentences.zh: 然變起一朝，禍積有素。

translations.literal: Yet though the change came in a morning, the calamity had long been gathering.
translations.idiomatic: Though sudden, the disaster had deep roots.

sentences.zh: 當今大患，惟在因循怠玩。

translations.literal: Today's great evil lies solely in routine delay and slackness.
translations.idiomatic: The grave evil of the age is procrastination and neglect.

sentences.zh: 雖經再三誥誡，舌敝筆禿，終不足以動諸臣之聽，朕惟返躬修省耳。

translations.literal: Though We have admonished again and again until tongues are worn and brushes worn out, it is still not enough to move Our ministers to listen; We can only turn inward and examine Ourselves.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated admonitions have failed to stir the ministers; We can only examine Ourselves.

sentences.zh: 諸臣原為忠良，即盡心力，匡朕之咎，正民之志，切勿依前屍位，益增朕失。

translations.literal: You ministers are by nature loyal and good; exert your utmost strength, correct Our faults, and set right the people's will—do not as before hold empty posts and add to Our errors.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers are loyal at heart: correct Our faults and the people's will, and do not hold empty posts that deepen Our guilt.

sentences.zh: 通諭知之。

translations.literal: Let this be proclaimed throughout."
translations.idiomatic: Let all know this."

sentences.zh: 」命那彥成為欽差大臣，剿賊河南。

translations.literal: Nayancheng was ordered Imperial Commissioner to suppress bandits in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng was sent as Imperial Commissioner to suppress Henan rebels.

sentences.zh: 以提督楊遇春、副都統富僧德、總兵楊芳帶兵協剿。

translations.literal: Regional commander Yang Yuchun, vice banner general Fusengde, and regional commander Yang Fang were ordered to bring troops in joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuchun, Fusengde, and Yang Fang were ordered to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，首逆林清就擒。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, chief rebel Lin Qing was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Lin Qing was taken.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上還京。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以松筠、曹振鏞為大學士，托津、百齡協辦大學士，鐵保、章煦為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Songyun and Cao Zhenyong were made Grand Secretaries; Tuojin and Bai Ling Associate Grand Secretaries; Tiebao and Zhang Xu Ministers of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Songyun and Cao Zhenyong entered the Grand Secretariat; Tuojin and Bai Ling as associates; Tiebao and Zhang Xu took Personnel.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，首逆林清、通逆內監劉進亨等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, chief rebel Lin Qing and collaborating eunuch Liu Jinheng and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Lin Qing, Liu Jinheng, and other collaborators were executed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，祖之望免，以韓崶為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen: Zu Zhiwang was removed; Han Fang was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingshen day, Zu Zhiwang was dismissed and Han Fang took Punishments.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，山東鹽運使劉清大破賊於扈家集，侍衛蘇爾慎復定陶、曹縣。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Shandong salt transport commissioner Liu Qing greatly defeated bandits at Hujiaji; guardsman Su Erzhen recovered Dingtao and Caoxian.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Liu Qing routed rebels at Hujiaji and Su Erzhen retook Dingtao and Caoxian.

sentences.zh: 御史張鵬展疏陳，百姓不敢出首邪匪，由於地方官規避處分，不為受理，或反坐誣。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Pengzhan memorialized that common people dared not report heterodox bandits because local officials, fearing disciplinary action, would not accept reports or would instead punish accusers with false charges.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pengzhan said locals feared reporting sect bandits because officials punished accusers instead.

sentences.zh: 上是之。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，那彥成奏各路調兵，再行進剿。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Nayancheng memorialized that troops were being assembled on all routes before advancing to suppress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Nayancheng reported gathering troops before attacking.

sentences.zh: 上嚴斥之。

translations.literal: The Emperor sternly rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked him sharply.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命托津往督河南軍務，桂芳入直軍機處。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Tuojin was ordered to supervise Henan military affairs; Guifang entered the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Tuojin supervised Henan and Guifang joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，恤禁城拒賊傷亡侍衛那倫等世職。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, hereditary offices were granted to guardsman Nalun and others who died resisting bandits in the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, hereditary ranks were granted to Nalun and others killed defending the palace.

sentences.zh: 己未，祿康、裕瑞失察屬人從逆，發盛京禁錮。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Lu Kang and Yurui failed to detect subordinates' rebellion and were sent to confinement at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Lu Kang and Yurui were confined at Mukden for failing to detect subordinates' treason.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，謫降漢軍籍、直隸籍之科道官。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, censors of Han Army and Zhili banner registration were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Han Army and Zhili banner censors were demoted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以明亮為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Mingliang was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Mingliang became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子朔，那彥成奏攻克道口賊巢，進圍滑城。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day jiazi: Nayancheng memorialized that the bandit nest at Daokou was taken and Huacheng besieged.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh-month new moon, jiazi, Nayancheng reported taking Daokou and besieging Huacheng.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，敕刪減公罪則例。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, public-penalty statutes were ordered revised and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, public-penalty statutes were ordered cut back.

sentences.zh: 壬申，通逆都司曹綸伏誅。

translations.literal: On day renshen, collaborating metropolitan garrison commander Cao Lun was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, collaborator Cao Lun was executed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，那彥成奏楊芳等攻克司寨山賊寨，殲斃首犯李文成。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Nayancheng memorialized that Yang Fang and others took the bandit stronghold at Mount Sizhai and killed chief culprit Li Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Nayancheng reported Yang Fang took Sizhai and killed Li Wencheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，命松筠、長齡籌議新疆經費。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingshen: Songyun and Chang Ling were ordered to plan Xinjiang expenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingshen day, Songyun and Chang Ling were told to plan Xinjiang funding.

sentences.zh: 丙午，那彥成奏攻克滑城，賊渠宋元成等伏誅，生擒牛亮臣等。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Nayancheng memorialized that Huacheng was taken; bandit chiefs Song Yuancheng and others were executed, and Niu Liangchen and others captured alive.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Nayancheng reported Huacheng fell; Song Yuancheng was executed and Niu Liangchen captured.

sentences.zh: 予那彥成三等男，楊遇春等以次獎敘有差。

translations.literal: Nayancheng was granted third-rank baron; Yang Yuchun and others were rewarded in descending order.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng received a third-rank baronage and Yang Yuchun and others were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 命托津留辦長垣賊匪。

translations.literal: Tuojin was ordered to remain and handle Changyuan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Tuojin was left to deal with Changyuan rebels.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、河南、湖南等省二十六州縣災賦。

translations.literal: That year, disaster tax was remitted in twenty-six prefectures and counties of Zhili, Henan, Hunan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster tax was forgiven in twenty-six counties of Zhili, Henan, and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 除江蘇、河南、湖南廢田田賦。

translations.literal: Abandoned-field tax was remitted in Jiangsu, Henan, and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Abandoned-field tax was forgiven in Jiangsu, Henan, and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、越南、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, Vietnam, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, Vietnam, and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十九年甲戌春正月壬午，以吳璥為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, spring, first month, day renwu: Wu Jun was made Hedong river-course governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 19, on first-month renwu, Wu Jun became Hedong river-course governor-general.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiawu: the Emperor held the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiawu day, the Emperor lectured on the Classics.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以晉昌為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Jinchang was made Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Jinchang became Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，成都將軍賽沖阿以剿陝西賊匪苗小一等，予三等男，長齡輕車都尉，楊遇春晉一等男。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Sichuan General Saichong'a, for suppressing Shaanxi bandit Miao Xiaoyi and others, was granted third-rank baron; Chang Ling light chariot commandant; Yang Yuchun promoted to first-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Saichong'a received a third-rank baronage for Shaanxi bandits; Chang Ling kept light-chariot rank; Yang Yuchun rose to first-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以富俊為吉林將軍，特依順保為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Fujun was made Jilin general; Te Yishunbao Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Fujun took Jilin and Te Yishunbao took Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，鐵保免，以英和為吏部尚書，奕紹為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Tiebao was removed; Yinghe was made Minister of Personnel; Yishao Han Army banner general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Tiebao was dismissed; Yinghe took Personnel and Yishao the Han Army banner.

sentences.zh: 以戴均元為左都御史。

translations.literal: Dai Junyuan was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Junyuan became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 閏二月甲子，以和寧為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day jiazi: Hening was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, on jiazi day, Hening became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 己丑，予死事滑縣知縣強克捷、教諭呂秉鈞、巡檢劉斌等世職。

translations.literal: On day jichou, hereditary offices were granted to Huaxian Magistrate Qiang Kejie, Instructor Lu Bingjun, Subprefectural Inspector Liu Bin, and others who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, hereditary ranks were granted to Qiang Kejie, Lu Bingjun, Liu Bin, and other officials killed in duty.

sentences.zh: 四月乙亥，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yihai: the Emperor reviewed Brave and Sharp camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yihai day, the Emperor reviewed Brave and Sharp troops.

sentences.zh: 豫親王裕豐失察屬人祝現入教，謀逆已發覺，不入奏，削爵。

translations.literal: Prince Yu Feng of the Prince Yu line failed to detect that his dependent Zhu Xian had joined the sect and, though the plot was discovered, did not memorialize; his title was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yu Feng lost his title for concealing Zhu Xian's sect membership and failing to report the plot.

sentences.zh: 以其弟裕興襲封。

translations.literal: His younger brother Yu Xing inherited the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Yu Xing inherited the princedom.

sentences.zh: 以興肇為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Xingzhao was made Han Army banner general.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhao became Han Army banner general.

sentences.zh: 壬午，漕運總督桂芳卒。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Grain Transport governor-general Guifang died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Guifang, grain transport governor-general, died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜龍汝言等二百二十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Long Ruyan and two hundred twenty-six others received jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Long Ruyan and 226 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，以和寧為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai: Hening was made Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guihai day, Hening became Rehe commandant.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day gengshen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth-month new moon, gengshen, there was an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以劉鐶之為戶部尚書，初彭齡為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Liu Huangzhi was made Minister of Revenue; Chu Pengling Minister of War, acting Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Liu Huangzhi took Revenue, Chu Pengling War while acting as Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: He acted as Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Pengling acted as Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiazi: the Emperor held the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiazi day, the Emperor lectured on the Classics.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大學士、威勤伯勒保再乞致仕，許之，命食伯俸。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Grand Secretary and Duke of Weiqin Lebao again begged to retire; this was granted, and he was ordered to receive a duke's stipend.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Lebao was allowed to retire on a duke's stipend.

sentences.zh: 以托津為大學士，明亮協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Tuojin was made Grand Secretary; Mingliang Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Tuojin entered the Grand Secretariat and Mingliang became associate.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上謁陵。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor visited the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上還京。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，以景安為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiwei: Jing'an was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiwei day, Jing'an became Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，以慶溥為左都御史。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yichou: Qing Pu was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yichou day, Qing Pu became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，江西巡撫阮元以擒捕土匪，加太子少保。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Jiangxi Governor Ruan Yuan was promoted to Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent for capturing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Ruan Yuan of Jiangxi was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent for suppressing bandits.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，命開墾伊犁、吉林荒地。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: orders were given to open wasteland in Ili and Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou day, reclamation was ordered in Ili and Jilin.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，百齡罷協辦大學士，以章煦為協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiwei: Bailin was removed as concurrent Grand Secretary; Zhang Xu was made concurrent Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Bailin left the concurrent grand secretary post and Zhang Xu took it.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Ancestral Temple received the collective seasonal rites.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸二縣、河南二縣、黑龍江各城災賦。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land taxes were remitted for two Zhili counties, two Henan counties, and every walled city of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: That year, flood taxes were forgiven in four counties and all Heilongjiang garrisons.

sentences.zh: 除奉天岫岩、浙江西安四縣廢田田賦。

translations.literal: Land taxes on abandoned fields were abolished in four counties including Xiuyan in Fengtian and Xi'an in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Abandoned-field taxes were ended in Xiuyan, Xi'an, and two other counties.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute missions came from Korea and Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 二十年乙亥春正月甲午，時享太廟，命智親王行禮。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, spring, first month, day jiawu: seasonal offerings at the Grand Temple; the Prince of Zhi was ordered to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20, on first-month jiawu, seasonal temple rites were entrusted to the Prince of Zhi.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiwei: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiwei day, the Emperor lectured on the classics.
