translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Emperor published an essay on remonstrating officials for the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day xinwei: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth-month new moon, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，以伊沖阿為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: Yichong'a was made Rehe banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Yichong'a became Rehe commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，免雲南銅廠逋銀。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: arrears silver for Yunnan copper mines was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Yunnan copper-mine arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Ancestral Temple received the collective seasonal rites.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸八縣、黑龍江三城災賦。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land tax was remitted for eight counties in Zhili and three cities in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: That year, eight Zhili counties and three Heilongjiang posts lost disaster taxes.

sentences.zh: 除奉天承德，直隸定州，江蘇丹徒、江陰，江西豐城，河南孟縣，福建侯官等縣水沖、河壓田賦。

translations.literal: Land tax was remitted for fields washed away or choked by rivers in Chengde in Fengtian, Dingzhou in Zhili, Dantu and Jiangyin in Jiangsu, Fengcheng in Jiangxi, Meng county in Henan, Houguan in Fujian, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Flood-wrecked fields in Chengde, Dingzhou, Dantu, Jiangyin, Fengcheng, Meng, Houguan, and elsewhere were tax-remitted.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、越南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Vietnam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Vietnam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十三年戊寅春正月戊申，特詔松筠勿沽名市惠，以保桑榆。

translations.literal: Year 23, wuyin, spring, first month, day wushen: a special edict ordered Songyun not to buy reputation by dispensing favors, in order to preserve his evening years.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 23, month 1, wushen, Songyun was told not to court popularity with favors.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔明亮年逾八旬，宜節勞頤養，勿庸常川入直，並免帶領引見承旨。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, an edict said Mingliang had passed eighty and should limit labor and nourish his health; he need no longer enter attendance daily and was exempted from leading candidacies for imperial rescript.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Mingliang at eighty was excused daily Grand Council attendance and leading rescript audiences.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，命戴均元、和寧為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu: Dai Junyuan and Hening were made Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, gengwu, Dai Junyuan and Hening joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 大學士董誥致仕，命食全俸。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Dong Gao retired; he was ordered full salary.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Gao retired on full pay.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor held the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Emperor lectured on the Classics.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor reviewed the Firearms Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Emperor reviewed the Firearms Brigade.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, gengzi, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以章煦為大學士，汪廷珍為禮部尚書，吳芳培為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Zhang Xu was made Grand Secretary, Wang Tingzhen Minister of Rites, and Wu Fangpei Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhang Xu became grand secretary; Wang Tingzhen, minister of rites; Wu Fangpei, left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上還京。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, new moon on day wuchen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the fourth-month new moon, wuchen, there was an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，風霾。

translations.literal: On day yihai, dusty haze wind.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, a dusty haze wind blew.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔曰：「昨日酉初三刻，暴風自東南來，塵霾四塞，燃燭始能辨色。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, an edict said: "Yesterday at the third quarter of you, a violent wind came from the southeast; dust haze filled all sides and lamps had to be lit to distinguish colors.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, an edict said that at you hour yesterday a southeast gale brought dust so thick that lamps were needed to see.

sentences.zh: 其象甚異。

translations.literal: The sign was very strange.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was very strange.

sentences.zh: 朕心震懼惕，思上蒼示警之因，稽諸洪範咎徵，蒙恆風若之義，皆朕蒞事不明、用人不當之所致也。

translations.literal: My heart was shaken and fearful in reflection; thinking on Heaven's reason for warning, consulting the Hong Fan on ominous signs and the meaning of constant wind as blame—all were caused by my governing matters unclearly and employing people improperly.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor blamed unclear governance and bad appointments for the omen, citing the Hong Fan on constant wind.

sentences.zh: 有言責者，體朕遇災而懼之心，剴切論列，無有所隱。

translations.literal: Those with the duty to speak should embody my heart of fear on meeting disaster, discuss earnestly, and conceal nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Censors were told to speak frankly in the spirit of his fear of the portent.

sentences.zh: 即下民有冤抑者，亦可據事代為直陳，以副朕修德弭災之意。

translations.literal: Even common people with grievances may present facts on their behalf frankly, to accord with my intent to cultivate virtue and quell calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners with grievances might also petition frankly to help him mend virtue and end the calamity.

sentences.zh: 」給事中盧浙疏言，風沙示警，請禁員弁貪功妄捕，擾累平民。

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.) Censor Lu Zhe memorialized that wind and sand were a warning and asked that officers and runners be forbidden to seek merit by reckless arrests that harassed civilians.
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended." Lu Zhe warned that reckless arrests for merit were harassing the people.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「所奏甚是。

translations.literal: Received rescript: "What you report is very correct.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript agreed: "Your report is correct.

sentences.zh: 林清案內逸犯飭緝，承緝員弁輒以他犯塞責。

translations.literal: Fugitives in the Lin Qing case were ordered seized, but seizing officers would fill the charge with other crimes to answer duty.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Qing fugitives were ordered seized, but catchers often substituted other cases.

sentences.zh: 番役兵丁，乘機肆虐，誣陷索扌虜，無所不至。

translations.literal: Itinerant constables and soldiers seized the chance to run wild, framing people and extorting captives, to every extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Runners and soldiers framed innocents and extorted victims without limit.

sentences.zh: 比到官審明，業已皮骨僅存，貲產盪盡，甚有因而殞命者。

translations.literal: By the time the court investigated and clarified, skin and bones alone remained, property was exhausted, and some even died thereby.
translations.idiomatic: By trial, victims were ruined and some had died.

sentences.zh: 冤苦莫訴，宜致斯災。

translations.literal: Bitter injustice with no redress—such things surely brought this calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Unredressed wrongs, he said, had brought the portent.

sentences.zh: 所有次要五十餘犯，概令停緝。

translations.literal: All more than fifty secondary offenders were ordered to stop pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuit of over fifty minor fugitives was halted.

sentences.zh: 即祝現等六犯，亦只交刑部存記，獲日辦理。

translations.literal: Even the six offenders including Zhu Xian were only handed to the Ministry of Punishments for record; if caught, then to be handled.
translations.idiomatic: Even six chief fugitives including Zhu Xian were only logged at Punishments until caught.

sentences.zh: 嗣後捕役有犯前情，該管官嚴刑重懲，以其家產付諸被誣之家，庶可儆惡習而安良懦。

translations.literal: Hereafter if arrest runners repeat the former conduct, the supervising official shall punish severely and award their household property to the framed family, so as to warn vicious custom and reassure the good and timid.
translations.idiomatic: Repeat offenders among catchers were to be flogged and their property given to victims.

sentences.zh: 」己卯，欽天監疏言：「謹按天文正義，天地四方昏濛，若下塵雨，名曰霾。

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day jimao, the Board of Astronomy memorialized: "We respectfully consult the Comprehensive Meaning of Astronomy: when the four quarters of heaven and earth are dim and blurred, as if dusty rain falls, it is called haze.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript ended." On jimao, Astronomy cited haze as dim heaven and earth like dusty rain.

sentences.zh: 故曰天地霾，君臣乖，大旱，又主米貴。

translations.literal: Thus it is said: heaven and earth in haze—ruler and ministers at odds, great drought, and also dear grain.
translations.idiomatic: The text linked haze to estranged ruler and ministers, drought, and dear grain.

sentences.zh: 」得旨：「初八日之事，正與正義之象相同。

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.) Received rescript: "The matter on the eighth day exactly matched the sign in the Comprehensive Meaning.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial ended." The rescript said the eighth day matched the omen.

sentences.zh: 惟朕恪遵成憲，日日召見臣工，前席周諮，似不致於乖離。

translations.literal: Yet I respectfully follow the established statutes, daily summoning officials and questioning before the mat at close range—one would seem not to reach estrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he said he daily consulted officials closely and seemed not estranged.

sentences.zh: 但此其跡也，其實與朕同心望治，有幾人哉！

translations.literal: But this is only the trace; in reality how many share my heart and hope for order!
translations.idiomatic: Appearances aside, few truly shared his zeal for order.

sentences.zh: 不敢面諍，退有後言，貌合而情暌，是即乖也。

translations.literal: Not daring to remonstrate to the face, speaking afterward—appearance united but feeling estranged: that is estrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Face-to-face silence and backbiting, he said, were estrangement.

sentences.zh: 其於同僚，不為君子之和而為小人之同，是亦乖也。

translations.literal: Toward colleagues, not the harmony of gentlemen but the conformity of petty men—that too is estrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Petty cliquishness among colleagues was estrangement too.

sentences.zh: 我君臣其交儆焉。

translations.literal: Let ruler and ministers admonish one another on this.
translations.idiomatic: Ruler and ministers should warn one another.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，上祈雨。

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day gengchen, the Emperor prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript ended." On gengchen, the Emperor prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上再祈雨。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor prayed for rain again.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, he prayed for rain again.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，雨。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，詔曰：「館臣呈進敕修明鑒，於萬曆、天啟載入先朝開創之事，又加按語頌揚，於體例均為未合。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu, an edict said: "Library ministers presented the imperially commissioned Mirror of Ming, which in the Wanli and Tianqi sections entered matters of the founding court of the former dynasty and added commentaries in praise—in all this the format was improper.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, wuxu, an edict rebuked the Mirror of Ming for praising the Ming founding in Wanli-Tianqi entries.

sentences.zh: 副總裁侍郎秀寧降為侍衛，前往新疆換班。

translations.literal: Vice chief compiler Vice Minister Xiuning was reduced to guard and sent to Xinjiang for rotation duty.
translations.idiomatic: Vice compiler Xiuning was demoted to guard and sent to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 正總裁曹振鏞等各予薄罰，另行纂輯。

translations.literal: Chief compiler Cao Zhenyong and others each received light punishment; compilation was reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: Chief compiler Cao Zhenyong and others were lightly punished and the work reassigned.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended."

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，武陟沁河溢，旋報合龍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen: Wuzhi's Qin River overflowed; soon word came the river was closed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, renshen, the Qin at Wuzhi flooded; the breach was soon closed.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，上東巡啟鑾。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiazi: the Emperor set out on an eastern tour.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, jiazi, the eastern tour began.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯朔，詔以取道民田，免經過奉天承德四州縣額賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day dingmao: because the route crossed civilian fields, quota land tax was remitted for four prefectures and counties of Fengtian and Chengde traversed.
translations.idiomatic: At the eighth-month new moon, four Fengtian-Chengde districts on the route lost land tax.

sentences.zh: 戊子，頒行皇朝通禮。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Imperial Rituals of the Dynasty was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Imperial Rituals of the Dynasty was issued.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上祭北鎮。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor sacrificed to the Northern Sacred Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Emperor sacrificed to the Northern Peak.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，謁永陵，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, he visited Yongling and performed the great felicity rite.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, he visited Yongling with the great felicity rite.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申朔，謁福陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day bingchen: he visited Fuling.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, bingchen, he visited Fuling.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，謁昭陵，均行大饗禮，詣寶冊前行禮。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, he visited Zhaoling; both received great felicity rites; rites were performed before the treasure registers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, he visited Zhaoling; both tombs received great felicity rites and rites before the registers.

sentences.zh: 上制再舉東巡慶成記。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed a Record of the Completion of the Second Eastern Tour.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote a record of the second eastern tour's completion.

sentences.zh: 臨奠克勤郡王岳託、武勛王揚古利、弘毅公額亦都、直義公費英東墓。

translations.literal: He visited and offered at the tombs of Prince Keqin Yuetuo, Prince of Martial Merit Yangguli, Duke Hongyi E'iyetu, and Duke of Straight Duty Fei Yingdong.
translations.idiomatic: He offered at the tombs of Yuetuo, Yangguli, E'iyetu, and Fei Yingdong.

sentences.zh: 加恩額亦都後裔五人，費英東後裔一人。

translations.literal: Added favor to five descendants of E'iyetu and one descendant of Fei Yingdong.
translations.idiomatic: Five of E'iyetu's descendants and one of Fei Yingdong's received added favor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上詣天壇、堂子行禮。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor went to the Altar of Heaven and the Tangzi to perform rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, he sacrificed at the Altar of Heaven and Tangzi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the imperial procession returned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the tour returned.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以富俊為吉林將軍，賽沖阿為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Fujun was made Jilin general and Saichonga Shengjing general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Fujun took Jilin and Saichonga, Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，上駐蹕興隆寺。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengwu: the Emperor halted at Xinglong Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, gengwu, the Emperor halted at Xinglong Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，萬壽節，行宮受賀。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Longevity Festival; congratulations were received at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Longevity Day was celebrated at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上還京。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，予告大學士董誥卒，上臨第賜奠。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, retired Grand Secretary Dong Gao died; the Emperor visited his residence to grant funeral offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Dong Gao died; the Emperor mourned at his house.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，以奕灝為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: Yihui was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wushen, Yihui became Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔曰：「國家臨御年久，宜加意於人心風俗。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, an edict said: "The state has ruled long; one should pay special attention to popular mind and custom.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, an edict urged attention to popular mind and custom.

sentences.zh: 而人心之正，風俗之醇，則系於政教之得失。

translations.literal: Yet the rectitude of minds and purity of customs depend on the gains and losses of government and teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Rectitude of mind and purity of custom, it said, depend on government and teaching.

sentences.zh: 其間消息甚微，系於國甚重，未可視為迂圖也。

translations.literal: The shifts are very subtle but bind the state heavily; it may not be treated as a remote design.
translations.idiomatic: Subtle shifts matter greatly and must not be dismissed as remote theory.

sentences.zh: 天下事有萬殊，理歸一是。

translations.literal: Affairs under heaven have myriad forms; principle returns to one.
translations.idiomatic: Myriad affairs, it said, still return to one principle.

sentences.zh: 從嚴、從寬，必准諸理。

translations.literal: Whether strict or lenient, one must measure by principle.
translations.idiomatic: Strictness and leniency must both follow principle.

sentences.zh: 施行所及，乃能大畏民志。

translations.literal: Only when application reaches widely can popular will be greatly awed.
translations.idiomatic: Only wide application can awe popular will.

sentences.zh: 民志定，民心正矣。

translations.literal: When popular will is settled, popular mind is rectified.
translations.idiomatic: Settled will, it said, means rectified minds.

sentences.zh: 凡我君臣，當以憂盛危明之心，不為苟且便安之計。

translations.literal: All we ruler and ministers should take a heart wary in prosperity and mindful in danger, not schemes of compromise for convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Ruler and ministers should stay wary in prosperity, not seek easy comfort.

sentences.zh: 其於風俗之淳薄，尤當時時體察，潛移默化，整綱飭紀，正人心以正風俗。

translations.literal: Especially as to the thickness or thinness of custom, one must constantly observe, transform silently, rectify the standards and discipline, rectify minds to rectify customs.
translations.idiomatic: Custom's strength must be watched, norms tightened, and minds corrected to correct custom.

sentences.zh: 亮工熙績，莫重於斯。

translations.literal: Bright accomplishment and great merit—nothing weighs more than this.
translations.idiomatic: No achievement outweighed this, the edict said.

sentences.zh: 期與內外臣工交勉之。

translations.literal: I look to encourage one another with inner and outer officials.
translations.idiomatic: He asked inner and outer officials to encourage one another.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended."

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，上祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuchen: the Emperor prayed for snow.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, wuchen, the Emperor prayed for snow.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以八十六為廣州將軍，松筠為禮部尚書，以劉鐶之為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Bashiliu was made Guangzhou general; Songyun Minister of Rites; Liu Kuanshi Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Bashiliu took Guangzhou; Songyun, rites; Liu Kuanshi, left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day renchen, joint winter sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the joint winter sacrifice was held at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免順天、直隸、山東、安徽、甘肅、雲南等省七十九州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land tax was remitted by degree for seventy-nine prefectures and counties in Shuntian, Zhili, Shandong, Anhui, Gansu, Yunnan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, seventy-nine districts in six provinces lost disaster taxes by degree.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十四年己卯春正月甲午朔，上六旬萬壽，頒詔覃恩，賜廷臣宴。

translations.literal: Year 24, jimao, spring, first month, new moon on day jiawu: the Emperor's sixtieth Longevity; an amnesty edict was issued and court ministers feasted.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 24, New Year jiawu, the sixtieth Longevity brought amnesty and a court feast.

sentences.zh: 封皇三子綿愷為惇親王，皇四子綿忻為瑞親王，皇長孫奕緯為貝勒。

translations.literal: The third imperial son Mianyi was enfeoffed Prince Dun; the fourth son Mianxin Prince Rui; the imperial grandson Yizhi a beile.
translations.idiomatic: Mianyi became Prince Dun, Mianxin Prince Rui, and Yizhi a beile.

sentences.zh: 晉封綿志、奕紹等有差。

translations.literal: Mianzhi, Yishao, and others were advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Mianzhi, Yishao, and others were promoted by degree.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，和寧免直軍機，以侍郎文孚為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Hening was relieved of routine Grand Council attendance; Vice Minister Wen Fu was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Hening left daily council duty and Wen Fu joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: the Emperor held the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiazi, the Emperor lectured on the Classics.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, jihai, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 己未，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，上還京。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiazi: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, jiazi, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor reviewed the Valiant and Sharp Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Emperor reviewed the Valiant and Sharp Brigade.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜陳沆等二百二十四人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Chen Fang and two hundred twenty-four others received jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Chen Fang and 224 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊子，罷鳳陽、九江兩關監督，由巡道兼理。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the superintendents of Fengyang and Jiujiang passes were abolished and the touring circuit intendant handled them jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Fengyang and Jiujiang pass superintendents were abolished; circuit intendants took over.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Emperor prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以松筠為內大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Songyun was made inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Songyun became inner minister.

sentences.zh: 閏四月己酉，上詣天神壇祈雨。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day jiyou: the Emperor prayed for rain at the Heavenly Spirit Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 4, jiyou, the Emperor prayed at the Heavenly Spirit Altar.

sentences.zh: 是日，雨。

translations.literal: That day, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，成親王永瑆以告祭禮愆，罷職削俸歸第。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiyou: Prince Cheng Yongxing, for faults in memorial sacrifice rites, was dismissed from office, salary cut, and sent to his residence.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, yiyou, Prince Cheng Yongxing lost office and pay for faulty sacrifice rites.

sentences.zh: 以英和、和世泰俱為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Yinghe and Heshitai were both made Manchu commanders-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghe and Heshitai became Manchu commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，調松筠為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: Songyun was transferred to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, guimao, Songyun moved to the Works ministry.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，以鄭親王烏爾恭阿為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renxu: Prince Zheng Ulgungga was made Chinese Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, renxu, Prince Zheng Ulgungga took the Chinese Banner command.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor went on tour to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor toured Mulan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，永定河決，命吳璥、那彥寶勘築。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Yongding River breached; Wu Jin and Nayanbao were ordered to survey and build dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Yongding broke; Wu Jin and Nayanbao were sent to survey and repair.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，河南蘭陽北岸河溢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao: the Yellow River overflowed on the north bank at Lanyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, the river flooded Lanyang's north bank in Henan.

sentences.zh: 予告大學士、威勤伯勒保卒，贈一等侯。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary on leave, Duke Weiqin Lebao, died and was posthumously enfeoffed as a first-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao, grand secretary on leave and Duke Weiqin, died and was made a first-class marquis posthumously.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，上還京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renxu: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷松筠御前大臣為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Songyun was removed as an imperial presence minister and made Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Songyun left the inner ministry and became Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，萬壽節，上御太和殿受賀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yiwei: on the Longevity Festival the Emperor received congratulations in the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on yiwei day, the Emperor received birthday felicitations at Taihe Hall.

sentences.zh: 侍郎周系英因參劾湖南客民焚殺，兼致私書，革職，並斥革其子舉人。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zhou Xiying, for impeaching Hunan migrant-guest arson and killing while also sending a private letter, was dismissed from office and his son, a provincial graduate, was likewise expelled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Xiying was dismissed and his graduate son disqualified for mixing a private letter into a Hunan migrant-violence impeachment.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，晉封明亮三等侯。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi: Mingliang was promoted to third-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yisi day, Mingliang was raised to third-class marquis.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，吳邦慶以奏覆湖南客民焚殺案不實，降官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengzi: Wu Bangqing was demoted for memorializing that the Hunan migrant-guest arson-and-killing case was untrue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Wu Bangqing was demoted for a false report on the Hunan migrant arson case.

sentences.zh: 丙午，董教增疏請洋船准販茶葉，得旨斥駁。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Dong Jiaozeng memorialized asking that foreign ships be allowed to sell tea; an edict sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Dong Jiaozeng's plea to let foreign ships sell tea was sharply rejected.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the temple seasonal rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、浙江、湖南等省三十九州縣衛災賦旗租有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster land tax and banner rent were remitted by varying amounts for thirty-nine prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Zhejiang, Hunan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year, thirty-nine disaster districts in Zhili, Zhejiang, Hunan, and elsewhere received partial tax and banner-rent relief.

sentences.zh: 除江蘇川沙廳、寶山縣廢地田賦。

translations.literal: Land tax on abandoned fields in Chuansha subprefecture and Baoshan county, Jiangsu, was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Abandoned-field taxes in Jiangsu's Chuansha and Baoshan were abolished.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、越南、暹羅、南掌入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, Vietnam, Siam, and Lan Xang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, Vietnam, Siam, and Lan Xang paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十五年庚辰春正月壬申，詔優恤老臣明亮、和寧等，毋庸來園帶領引見。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, day renshen: an edict gave preferential care to aged ministers including Mingliang and Hening, who need not come to the gardens to lead presentation audiences.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25, on the first-month renshen day, Mingliang, Hening, and other aged ministers were excused from garden presentation audiences.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jichou: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jichou day, the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，章煦以疾致仕，以戴均元為大學士，吳璥協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Zhang Xu retired for illness; Dai Junyuan was made Grand Secretary and Wu Jin associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Zhang Xu retired; Dai Junyuan became grand secretary and Wu Jin, associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor reviewed the Firearms Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor inspected the Firearms Camp.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，慶郡王永璘有疾，上臨視，晉封親王。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Prince of Qing Yonglin fell ill; the Emperor visited him in person and promoted him to prince of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the ailing Prince of Qing Yonglin was visited and raised to full prince.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 兵部遺失行印，事聞，明亮以次罰降有差。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War lost its traveling seal; when the matter was reported, Mingliang and others were fined and demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: After the War Ministry lost its traveling seal, Mingliang and others were demoted by degree.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上詣明成祖、宣宗、孝宗陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor offered libations at the tombs of the Ming founders Chengzu, Xuanzong, and Xiaozong.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Emperor poured libations at Chengzu, Xuanzong, and Xiaozong's tombs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，慶親王永璘薨。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Prince of Qing Yonglin died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Prince of Qing Yonglin died.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上還京。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 臨故慶親王第賜奠，命其子綿慜襲郡王。

translations.literal: He visited the late prince's mansion to grant mourning gifts and ordered his son Mianmin to succeed as Prince of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: At the late prince's house he granted mourning rites and made Mianmin Prince of Qing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，上詣八里庄慶僖親王殯所賜奠。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: the Emperor went to Balizhuang to grant mourning at the bier of the late Prince Qingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on jiawu day, he mourned at Balizhuang for Prince Qingxi.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賜陳繼昌等二百四十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Chen Jichang and two hundred forty-six others received jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Chen Jichang and 246 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，禁王公私設諳達及買民女為妾。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: princes were forbidden to set up private language masters or buy commoners' daughters as concubines.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guimao day, princes were barred from private andars and buying commoner concubines.

sentences.zh: 松筠黜為驍騎校。

translations.literal: Songyun was demoted to Commandant of Brave Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun was reduced to commandant of brave cavalry.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，上巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: the Emperor went on tour to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on renshen day, the Emperor toured Mulan.

sentences.zh: 方受疇等疏呈嘉禾。

translations.literal: Fang Shoudi and others memorialized presenting fine grain.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Shoudi and others presented a memorial of fine grain.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the court halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the court stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上不豫，鄉夕大漸。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor fell ill; by evening his condition grew critical.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor fell ill and was gravely ill by nightfall.

sentences.zh: 宣詔立皇次子智親王為皇太子。

translations.literal: An edict was proclaimed installing the second imperial son, Prince of Zhi, as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict installed the second son, Prince of Zhi, as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 日加戌，上崩於行宮，年六十有一。

translations.literal: At the double-hour xu the Emperor died at the traveling palace, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: At the xu hour he died at the traveling palace, aged sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，奉移梓宮還京。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: the coffin was escorted back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi day, the coffin was brought back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，恭上尊諡曰受天興運敷化綏猷崇文經武孝恭勤儉端敏英哲睿皇帝，廟號仁宗。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiachen: the posthumous honorific Shoutian Xingyun Fuhua Suiyou Chongwen Jingwu Xiaogong Qinjian Duanmin Yingzhe Rui Huangdi was respectfully submitted; temple name Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the full posthumous title and temple name Renzong were conferred.

sentences.zh: 道光元年三月癸酉，葬昌陵。

translations.literal: Third month of Daoguang 1, day guiyou: burial at Changling Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1, third month, he was buried at Changling.

sentences.zh: 論曰：仁宗初逢訓政，恭謹無違。

translations.literal: The commentators say: At first Renzong met tutelage in government and was reverent without breach.
translations.idiomatic: The annalists say Renzong began under tutelage and obeyed without deviation.

sentences.zh: 迨躬蒞萬幾，鋤奸登善。

translations.literal: When he personally took the myriad affairs in hand, he uprooted the wicked and advanced the good.
translations.idiomatic: Once he ruled in person, he rooted out traitors and promoted the worthy.

sentences.zh: 削平逋寇，捕治海盜，力握要樞，崇儉勤事，闢地移民，皆為治之大原也。

translations.literal: He pacified lingering bandits, seized sea pirates, firmly held key levers, honored frugality and diligent service, and opened land to resettle migrants—all great foundations of rule.
translations.idiomatic: He crushed bandits and pirates, held power firmly, prized thrift and diligence, and opened land for settlers—the great foundations of his rule.

sentences.zh: 詔令數下，諄切求言。

translations.literal: Edicts issued again and again, earnestly seeking counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Edict after edict earnestly sought honest counsel.

sentences.zh: 而吁咈之風，未遽睹焉，是可嘅已。

translations.literal: Yet the climate of open remonstrance was not soon seen—at this one may sigh.
translations.idiomatic: Yet open remonstrance did not quickly appear—and at that one sighs.
